n-m-h2-explog-07.title: Haddii aan ognahay qiimaha hal logarithm, ma heli karnaa log₆12?
n-m-h2-explog-07.goal: Baar macluumaadka loo baahan yahay si loo helo logarithm-ka bartilmaameedka, oo naftaada u hel tibaax ah hal qiime p.
n-m-h2-explog-07.material: Eunseo wuxuu rabaa inuu helo log_6 12 isagoo aan xisaabiye isticmaalin. Haddii loo sheego hal ka mid ah qiimayaasha hoose oo keliya, wuxuu rabaa inuu hubiyo haddii uu log_6 12 ku muujin karo qiimahaas isagoo isticmaalaya sifooyinka logarithm-ka iyo afarta hawlood ee xisaabeed oo keliya. (log_6 12 waa logarithm-ka 12 ee salkiisu yahay 6.)
n-m-h2-explog-07.thinking.1: U dhimidda isla qiime adigoo beddelaya salka
n-m-h2-explog-07.prereq.2: Xiriirka u dhexeeya is-rogayaasha iyo logarithm-yada
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.prompt: Dooro dhammaan qiimayaasha oo ah in ogaanshaha hal qiime oo keliya uu kuu ogolaado inaad log_6 12 ku muujiso isticmaalaya sifooyinka logarithm-ka iyo afarta hawlood ee xisaabeed oo keliya.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.hint.0: Isku day inaad salka log_6 12 u beddesho 2 ama 3, ama inaad 12 iyo 6 u qorto wax-soo-saar 2 iyo 3, si aad u aragto kee logarithm keliya ayaa muujin kara.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.hint.1: Mid mid hubi haddii doorasho kasta ay wadato isla macluumaadka sida logarithm-kaas (haddii loogu beddeli karo qaacido).
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.r.a: log_10 2 oo keliya, ma ogaan kartid log_10 3, sidaas darteed ma muujin kartid labada 12 iyo 6.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.r.b: Waxaad seegtay macluumaadka u beddela hal logarithm, sida log_2 6=1+log_2 3.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.r.c: Waxaad seegtay in isticmaalka log_6 3=1−log_6 2 uu kuu ogolaanayo inaad muujiso log_6 12.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.r.d: Xiriir kuma laha 2 iyo 3, sidaas darteed ma caawiso.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.r.e: Waxaad seegtay in log_3 2 uu yahay is-rogaha log_2 3.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.r.f: Waxaad seegtay in beddelidda log_6 12 salka 2 ay ka tagto log_2 3 oo keliya.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.explain: log_6 12=log_2 12/log_2 6=(2+log_2 3)/(1+log_2 3), sidaas darteed p=log_2 3 oo keliya ayaa ku filan. log_2 6=1+p, log_3 2=1/p, iyo log_6 2=1/(1+p) sidoo kale waxaa loo beddeli karaa p iyo ka dhanka kale. log_10 2 ma shaqeeyo haddii aadan ogayn log_10 3, log_5 7 na xiriir lama laha 2 iyo 3.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s2.prompt: Ha noqoto p=log_2 3. Muuji log_6 12 marka loo eego p.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s2.hint.0: U beddel salka 2 oo koreeyaha iyo hooseeyaha mid kasta u qor sida qiimayaasha log_2.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s2.hint.1: Qor log_2 12 iyo log_2 6 sida wax-isku-dhufashada 2 iyo 3, oo isticmaal sifada logarithm-yada si aad u muujiso marka loo eego p.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Odhaahdaada leh p, ma dhigtay koreeyaha iyo hooseeyaha si sax ah?
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma beddelay p=1.585 oo ma hubisay in log_6 12≈1.387?
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s2.model.1: U beddelidda salka 2 waxay siinaysaa log_2 12 / log_2 6 = (2+p)/(1+p).

n-m-h2-explog-09.title: Xukunka isle'egta u dhexeysa garaafyada shaqooyinka exponential iyo logarithmic
n-m-h2-explog-09.goal: Hubi sheegashooyinka isle'egta u dhexeysa dhowr garaaf adigoo isticmaalaya qaacidooyin si aad u go'aamiso kuwa run iyo been, oo muuji sababta hal sheegasho hal qaacidada.
n-m-h2-explog-09.material: Seungwoo wuxuu soo koobay xiriirada isle'egta u dhexeeya garaafyada shaqooyinka exponential iyo logarithmic oo leh salal 2 iyo 1/2. Logarithm-ka leh sal 1/2 waxaa loo qoraa log_{1/2}x.
n-m-h2-explog-09.thinking.1: U beddelidda xiriirada u dhexeeya garaafyada qaacidooyin
n-m-h2-explog-09.thinking.2: Helidda isle'egta saxda ah ee sheegasho khaldan
n-m-h2-explog-09.prereq.1: Shaqooyinka rogan iyo isle'egta ku saabsan xariiqda y=x
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.prompt: Dooro dhammaan hadallada saxda ah ee Seungwoo soo koobay.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.hint.0: Lammaane garaafyo kasta, dooro hal bar oo hel isku-duwayaasheeda, oo hubi sida barta loo wareejin lahaa si ay uga degto garaafka kale.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.hint.1: Marka hore qor sida isle'egta ku saabsan ulaha y iyo isle'egta ku saabsan xariiqda y=x u beddelaan isku-duwayaasha bar.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.o.a: Garaafyada y=2^x iyo y=(1/2)^x waa isle'eg ulaha y
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.r.a: Maadaama (1/2)^x=2^(−x), waa garaafka calaamadda x la beddelay. Waxaad ka tagtay hadal sax ah.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.o.b: Garaafyada y=log_2 x iyo y=log_{1/2} x waa isle'eg ulaha y
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.r.b: Shaqooyinka log waxaa lagu qeexay x>0 oo keliya, sidaas darteed ma noqon karaan isle'eg ulaha y.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.o.c: Garaafyada y=2^x iyo y=log_2 x waa isle'eg xariiqda y=x
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.r.c: Waa shaqooyin rogan midba midka kale, sidaas darteed waa isle'eg y=x. Waxaad ka tagtay hadal sax ah.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.o.d: Garaafyada y=2^x iyo y=log_{1/2} x waa isle'eg xariiqda y=x
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.r.d: Shaqada rogan ee 2^x waa log_2 x, ma aha log_{1/2} x.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.explain: Maadaama (1/2)^x=2^(−x), y=2^x iyo y=(1/2)^x waa isle'eg ulaha y. y=2^x iyo y=log_2 x waa shaqooyin rogan midba midka kale, sidaas darteed waa isle'eg y=x. log_{1/2} x wuxuu leeyahay aag qeexid x>0, sidaas darteed ma noqon karo isle'eg ulaha y, mana aha shaqada rogan ee 2^x sidoo kale.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.prompt: Qor xariiqda garaafyada y=log_2 x iyo y=log_{1/2} x ay ku isle'eg yihiin, oo muuji sababta qaacidada.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.hint.0: Dib u qor log_{1/2} x sida logarithm leh sal 2. Barbar dhig qiimayaasha y ee labada qaacidood isla x.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.hint.1: Eeg sida qiimayaasha y isu xiriiraan, oo sheeg jihada dhidibka ay xiriirkaasi bar ku dhaqaajiyo.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma heshay log_{1/2} x=−log_2 x adigoo beddelay salka?
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Adigoo isticmaalaya isku-duwayaasha bar, ma tiri isla x labada qiime ee y waxay ku kala duwan yihiin calaamadda oo keliya?
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma tiri sida isle'egta ku saabsan ulaha x ay bar u dhaqaajiso?
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.model.0: log_{1/2} x=log_2 x / log_2(1/2)=−log_2 x. Isla x qiimayaasha y waxay ku kala duwan yihiin calaamadda oo keliya, sidaas darteed garaafyadu waa isle'eg ulaha x.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.model.1: Waa isle'eg ulaha x. U beddelidda salka waxay u beddelaysaa log_{1/2} x −log_2 x, sidaas darteed waa garaafka halka barta (x, y) loo dhaqaajiyey (x, −y).
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.model.2: Waa isle'eg ulaha x. y=log_{1/2} x waa isla y=−log_2 x, sidaas darteed qiimayaasha y ee labada garaaf waxay leeyihiin calaamado ka soo horjeeda.

n-m-h2-explog-05.title: U sharaxidda saaxiib sababta aan u tuurno t=−1
n-m-h2-explog-05.goal: Marka la xallinayo isla'eg jibbaar ah adigoo beddelaya, isticmaal xadka xarafka la beddelay si aad sababta xalka loo tuuray ugu dhigto erayo saaxiib uu fahmi karo.
n-m-h2-explog-05.material: Kuwani waa qoraallada Jiho ee xallinaya 4^x−3·2^x−4=0. "Ha noqdo 2^x=t. Markaas t²−3t−4=0, (t−4)(t+1)=0, sidaas darteed t=4 ama t=−1. t=−1 ma ahan mid sax ah, sidaas darteed waan tuuraynaa, laga bilaabo 2^x=4, x=2." Sora wuxuu arkay qoraalladan wuxuuna weydiiyay, "Maxaad u tuurtay t=−1 si fudud? Waxaan u malaynayaa inay jiri karto x oo 2^x=−1."
n-m-h2-explog-05.thinking.1: U beddelidda jumlad xal oo adag erayo fudud
n-m-h2-explog-05.thinking.2: Ku dabaqidda xaalad isku nooc ah
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.prompt: Marka aad ka dhigto 2^x=t, dooro xadka saxda ah ee t qaadan karto.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.hint.0: Geli x tirooyin dhan, tirooyin taban, iyo 0 oo qor dhowr qiime oo 2^x qaadato.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.hint.1: Eeg xadkee ayay qiimayaasha aad qortay ku dhacaan, oo ka fikir haddii x jiro oo siinaya 0.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad u malaysay 0 sidoo kale waa suurtogal. Ka fikir haddii x jiro oo 2^x=0.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.r.b: Waxaad ogtahay in 2^x uu qaadanayo qiimayaal ka weyn 0 oo keliya.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.r.c: Waxaad seegtay kiisaska 2^x uu ka yar yahay 1 marka x taban yahay.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.r.d: Waxaad seegtay in shaqo jibbaar ah aanay qaadan karin qiimayaal taban.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.explain: Tiro run ah x kasta, 2^x wuxuu qaadanayaa qiimayaal ka weyn 0 oo keliya. Marka x aad u yaraado, 2^x wuxuu u dhowaadaa 0 laakiin marna ma noqdo 0. Sidaas darteed xadka t=2^x waa t>0.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.prompt: Qor jawaab u dhiibid Sora. Dib u qor "t=−1 ma ahan mid sax ah, sidaas darteed waan tuuraynaa" si Sora u fahmi karo, oo sharax sababta x oo 2^x=−1 aysan u jirin. (Ku dhawaad 3 jumladood)
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.hint.0: Ku bilow erayo Sora yaqaan. Maxay tahay in aad tusaalayaal ka bixiso qiimayaasha aad hesho marka aad geliso dhowr qiime x 2^x?
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.hint.1: Halkii aad isticmaali lahayd erayga "ma ahan mid sax ah," jumladaada ku dhig xadkee qiimayaasha 2^x qaadan karo.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma isticmaashay erayo Sora yaqaan (tusaale, qiimayaasha aad hesho marka aad geliso dhowr qiime x 2^x)?
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma bixisay sabab cad halkii erayga "ma ahan mid sax ah"?
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma sidoo kale tilmaantay sababta t=4 loo isticmaali karo?
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.model.0: Sora, haddii aad geliso x=1, 0, −3 2^x, waxaad heshaa 2, 1, 1/8, dhammaantoodna waa ka weyn yihiin 0. Si kasta oo aad u beddesho x, 2^x marna ma noqdo mid taban, sidaas darteed x oo 2^x=−1 ma jirto. Sidaas darteed waan tuuraynaa t=−1 oo waxaan isticmaalnaa t=4 oo keliya.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.model.1: Inta jeer ee aad ku dhufato ama u qaybiso 2, had iyo jeer waxaad heshaa tiro togan. 2^x wuxuu qaadanayaa qiimayaal ka weyn 0 oo keliya, sidaas darteed 2^x=−1 waa suurtogal ma aha. t=4 waa togan yahay, sidaas darteed wuxuu siinayaa x=2.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.model.2: t=2^x had iyo jeer waa togan yahay. Sidaas darteed haddii aad hesho tiro taban sida t=−1, x sidaas ah ma jirto oo keliya. Taasi ma aha qalad xallinta, waa sababtoo ah dabeecadda 2^x.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.prompt: Dooro tirada xalalka runta ah ee isla'egta 9^x−2·3^x−3=0.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.hint.0: Ha noqdo 3^x=t, u xall isla'egta t, oo hel dhammaan qiimayaasha t.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.hint.1: Qiime kasta oo t ah oo aad heshay, hubi haddii x jiro oo buuxiya 3^x=t.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.r.a: Waxaad ku xidhay labada qiime ee t x.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.r.b: Waxaad seegtay kiiska t ay togan tahay. Hubi qiimayaasha t ee aad heshay mid mid.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.r.c: Waxaad ogaatay in t=−1 aanu siinayn xal oo t=3 oo keliya la isticmaalo.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.r.d: Mar kale tiri xiriirka u dhexeeya tirada xalalka t iyo tirada xalalka x.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.explain: Haddii aan ka dhigno 3^x=t, markaas t²−2t−3=(t−3)(t+1)=0. t=3 wuxuu siinayaa x=1 laga bilaabo 3^x=3, t=−1 na xal ma siiyo sababtoo ah 3^x>0. Sidaas darteed waxaa jira hal xal oo run ah, x=1.

n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.prompt: Macluumaadka waxaa la muujiyaa hal qayb mar. Tallaabo kasta, dooro xukun ku salaysan waxa aad ilaa hadda taqaan oo keliya.
n-m-h2-diff-04.title: Sidee loo go'aamiyaa tirada xididdada dhabta ah?
n-m-h2-diff-04.topic: Qaabka garaafka shaqada saddex-jibbaaran iyo xididdada dhabta ah ee isla'eg
n-m-h2-diff-04.goal: Mar kasta oo macluumaad lagu daro, dib u eeg xukunkaaga ku saabsan tirada xididdada dhabta ah ee kala duwan ee isla'eg saddex-jibbaaran, oo sharax xadka halka calaamadaha iyo tirada qiimayaasha ugu badan iyo ugu yar ay isbeddelaan.
n-m-h2-diff-04.material: Tixgeli tirada xididdada dhabta ah ee kala duwan ee isla'egta saddex-jibbaaran x³−3x²+k=0 (k waa joogto). Ha noqoto f(x)=x³−3x²+k, oo samee xukun mar kasta oo macluumaad la muujiyo.
n-m-h2-diff-04.thinking.0: Hakinta xukun marka macluumaadku yar yahay
n-m-h2-diff-04.thinking.1: Akhrinta tirada xididdada dhabta ah qaabka garaafka
n-m-h2-diff-04.thinking.2: Baadhista gooni gooni ah ee qiimayaasha xadka halka tirada ay isbeddesho
n-m-h2-diff-04.prereq.0: Ugu badnaanta iyo ugu yaraanta gudaha ee shaqada saddex-jibbaaran iyo qaabka garaafkeeda
n-m-h2-diff-04.prereq.1: Xididdada dhabta ah ee isla'eg iyo baraha garaafku ku kulmo ulaha x
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.hint.0: Mar kasta oo macluumaad cusub soo baxo, ka fikir haddii xukunkaaga u baahan yahay in la beddelo.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.hint.1: Sawir imisa jeer ayuu garaafku ka gudbaa ulaha x iyadoo la eegayo calaamadaha ugu badnaanta gudaha iyo ugu yaraanta gudaha.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.info: f(x)=x³−3x²+k waa shaqo saddex-jibbaaran oo isku-dhufteyaasha hogaaminaya yahay togan, qiimaha k na weli lama ogaan.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Imisa xidid oo dhab ah oo kala duwan ayay isla'egta f(x)=0 leedahay?
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Labada dhammaad ee garaafka saddex-jibbaaran waa go'an yihiin, mid kor u socda mid hoos u socdana, sidaas darteed wuxuu ku kulmaa ulaha x ugu yaraan hal mar. Laakiin imisa jeer ayuu ku kulmaa waxay ku xidhan tahay halka ugu badnaanta gudaha iyo ugu yaraanta gudaha ay yaalaan.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Mar walba 3, k kasta oo uu yahay
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Waxay isku qasday xaqiiqda aljabrada ah ee isla'eg saddex-jibbaaran uu leeyahay 3 xidid iyo tirada xididdada dhabta ah ee kala duwan.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Waxay noqon kartaa 1, 2, ama 3 iyadoo ku xidhan k
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Waxay aragtay in tirada jeerarka garaafku ku kulmo ulaha x ay kala duwanaan karto k.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Had iyo jeer 1, k kasta ha ahaato
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Waxay sheegtay in garaafku isaga gooyo dhidibka x hal mar oo keliya.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Waxba ma odhan karno sababtoo ah ma ognin k
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Xataa ma sheegin xadka suurtagalka ah ee tirada. Waxaa jira wax laga ogaan karo qaabka hawl saddex-jibbaaran.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.info: f'(x)=3x(x−2), sidaa darteed x=0 waxaa ka jira ugu sarreeya deegaan, x=2 na ugu hooseeya deegaan. Qiimaha ugu sarreeya deegaanku waa f(0)=k, qiimaha ugu hooseeya deegaanku na waa f(2)=k−4.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Marka k=1, imisa xidid oo dhab ah oo kala duwan ayaa jira?
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Haddii k=1, qiimaha ugu sarreeya deegaanku waa 1 (togan) qiimaha ugu hooseeya deegaanku na waa −3 (taban). Garaafku wuxuu ka kacaa dhammaadka bidix, wuxuu gooyaa dhidibka x, wuxuu gaadhaa ugu sarreeya deegaanka, wuu hoos u dhacaa, wuxuu gooyaa dhidibka x, wuxuu gaadhaa ugu hooseeya deegaanka, oo mar kale wuu kacaa oo wuu gooyaa dhidibka x, sidaa darteed waxaa jira 3 xidid oo dhab ah oo kala duwan.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Waxay aragtay oo keliya in qiimaha ugu sarreeya deegaanka 1 uu yahay togan oo waxay u malaysay in garaafku dhidibka ku dhacayo hal mar.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Waxay ka fikirtay xaaladda garaafku dhidibka x taabanayo. Taasi waxay quseysaa kaliya marka qiime xad ah uu saxda yahay 0.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Waxay aragtay in ugu sarreeya deegaanku yahay togan, ugu hooseeya deegaanku na yahay taban, sidaa darteed garaafku wuxuu gooyaa dhidibka x saddex jeer.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Macluumaad dheeraad ah ayaa loo baahan yahay si loo ogaado
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Marka k=1, qiimaha ugu sarreeya deegaanka iyo qiimaha ugu hooseeya deegaanka labaduba waa go'aamiyeen.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Beddelidda k waxay kor ama hoos u dhaqaaqdaa garaafka, sidaa darteed calaamadaha qiimaha ugu sarreeya deegaanka k iyo qiimaha ugu hooseeya deegaanka k−4 waxay ku xiran yihiin k, waxaana jira waqtiyo mid ka mid ah uu noqdo 0.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Qiimaha k kee ayaa jira saxda 2 xidid oo dhab ah oo kala duwan?

n-m-h2-trig-10.title: Cabbirrada xagallada iyo cabbirrada saamiyada saddexagalka ee saddexagal
n-m-h2-trig-10.goal: Shuruudda A, B, C inay yihiin xagallada gudaha ee saddexagal, xukun jihada barbar dhigga cabbirrada xagallada ay ugu gudbaan barbar dhigga qiimayaasha sin, cos, tan, oo sababo ku bixi adigoo isticmaalaya sharciga sine-ka iyo xagallada ballaadhan.
n-m-h2-trig-10.material: Afar arday ayaa sameeyey sheegashooyinka soo socda ee ku saabsan saddexda xagal ee gudaha A, B, C ee saddexagal ABC. Tixgeli kaliya kiisaska halka qiimayaasha saamiyada saddexagalka la qeexay.
n-m-h2-trig-10.thinking.0: Xukun haddii bayaan run yahay ama been yahay shuruudihiisa dhexdooda
n-m-h2-trig-10.thinking.1: Ku xidh xagallada iyo dhinacyada sharciga sine-ka
n-m-h2-trig-10.prereq.1: Sifada ah dhinaca ka soo horjeeda xagalka weyn waa dhinaca ka dheer
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.prompt: Dooro dhammaan sheegashooyinka mar walba sax ah saddexagal ABC.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.hint.0: Geli xagallo gaar ah (30°, 100°, iwm.) halka A iyo B sheegasho kasta.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.hint.1: Isticmaal sharciga sine-ka si aad u beddesho sinA iyo sinB dhererrada dhinacyada, oo qor sida barbar dhigga cabbirku u soo baxo.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.r.a: Tani waxay xukuntaa in xagal weyn uu leeyahay qiime sine ah oo weyn. Waad hubin kartaa adigoo barbar dhigaya dhererrada dhinacyada ka soo horjeeda labada xagal adigoo isticmaalaya sharciga sine-ka.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.r.b: Tani waxay xukuntaa in cosine weyn macnaheedu yahay xagal weyn. Eeg sida qiimaha cosine-ku isu beddelo marka xagalku ka kordho 0° ilaa 180°.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.r.c: Waxaad u beddeshay cabbirka qiimayaasha sine dhererrada dhinacyada si aad u barbar dhigto oo waxaad isticmaashay xaqiiqda ah in dhinaca ka weyn uu ka soo horjeedo xagalka ka weyn.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.r.d: Waxaad ka dhex ilawday in xagal saddexagal uu noqon karo ballaadhan. Barbar dhig labada qiime tan marka A=30° iyo B=100°.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.explain: Sharciga sine-ka, a=2R·sinA iyo b=2R·sinB, sidaas darteed sinA>sinB waxay le'eg tahay a>b, maadaama dhinaca ka weyn uu ka soo horjeedo xagalka ka weyn, waxay sidoo kale le'eg tahay A>B. Sidaas darteed a iyo c labaduba waa sax. Haddii cosA>cosB, markaas A<B, sidaas darteed b waa rogan, tan na waa taban xagal ballaadhan, sidaas darteed marka A=30° iyo B=100°, tanA>tanB laakiin A<B, taasoo ka dhigaysa d been.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.prompt: Sharax sababta "haddii sinA>sinB, markaas A>B" saddexagal ugu run tahay (c), oo bixi hal tusaale lid ku ah muujinaya in (d) aanay run ahayn.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.hint.0: Dib u qor sinA iyo sinB sida dhererrada dhinacyada adigoo isticmaalaya sharciga sine-ka.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.hint.1: Ka dhig mid ka mid ah A iyo B ballaadhan oo ka fikir calaamadda qiimaha tan.

n-m-h2-diff-09.material: Kani waa xalka Soeun, arday yar, oo helay baaxadda joogtada a ee shaqada f(x)=x³+ax²+3x ay kordho dhammaan lambarrada dhabta ah. Soeun wuxuu si faan leh u tusay xalkan. (x³ waxay la macno tahay x oo saddex-jibbaaran, ax²-na waxay la macno tahay a jeer x laba-jibbaaran.)
n-m-h2-diff-09.thinking.0: Helista safka xalka halkaas oo shuruudda si aad u xoog badan loo isticmaalay
n-m-h2-diff-09.thinking.1: Tijaabinta qiyamka xadka a=±3 adigoo bedelaya
n-m-h2-diff-09.thinking.2: Dib u qorista si arday yar u raaci karo
n-m-h2-diff-09.prereq.0: Calaamadda derivative-ka iyo kordhka/hoos u dhaca shaqo
n-m-h2-diff-09.prereq.1: Shuruudda (kala sooca) ee aan-sinnaan laba-jibbaaran ay run u tahay dhammaan lambarrada dhabta ah
n-m-h2-diff-09.prereq.2: Qaabka saddex-jibbaarka buuxa ee tibaax saddex-jibbaaran
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.prompt: Dooro safka ugu horreeya ee khaldan ee xalka Soeun.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.hint.0: Hubi mid mid aasaaska safaf kasta uga yimid safka isla markiiba ka horreeya.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.hint.1: Ka fikir haddii "kordhayso" iyo "derivative-ku waa togan yahay" ay isku macne yihiin.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.line.1: Si f u kordho dhammaan lambarrada dhabta ah, f'(x)>0 waa inay run noqotaa dhammaan x dhab ah.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.line.2: Haddii D uu yahay kala soocida f'(x)=0, D/4=a²−9<0 ayaa loo baahan yahay.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.explain: Safka 2 waa kan ugu horreeya ee khaldan. Si shaqo u kordho, f'(x)≥0 waa ku filan yahay; ma aha inay noqoto f'(x)>0. Haddii f'(x) uu yahay 0 hal bar oo keliya oo meelaha kale uu togan yahay, shaqadu wali waa kordhaysaa barta dhexdeeda. Safafka 3 iyo 4 waxay raacaan safka 2, sidaas darteed xadku wuu maqan yahay baaxadda ka dhalatay.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.prompt: Waxaad rabtaa inaad hubiso haddii f ay kordhayso dhammaan lambarrada dhabta ah marka a=3, taas oo xadka ku jirta. Waa kee habka ugu habboon?
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.hint.0: Geli a=3 f(x) oo jajabi, ama dib u qor qaabka laba-jibbaarka buuxa ama saddex-jibbaarka buuxa.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.hint.1: Qor waa maxay calaamadda f' xoogaa ka hor iyo xoogaa ka dib barta f'(x) uu yahay 0.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.o.a: Xukun inaanay kordhayn, sababtoo ah a=3 waxaa jira x oo leh f'(x)=0
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.r.a: Xitaa haddii derivative-ku yahay 0 hal bar, shaqadu way kordhaysaa haddii calaamaddu aysan isbeddelin ka hor iyo ka dib. Waa inaad hubisaa ka hor intaadan xukumin.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.o.b: U tixgeli inaan hubin gooni gooni looga baahnayn, sababtoo ah waa qiime ka baxsan −3<a<3
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.r.b: Haddii uu yahay qiime xad ah waa sida saxda ah su'aasha, sidaas darteed hubin ayaa loo baahan yahay.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.o.c: Xisaabi calaamadda f' x=0 oo keliya
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.r.c: Calaamadda hal bar ma go'aamin karto haddii f kordhayso dhammaan lambarrada dhabta ah.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.o.d: Geli a=3, fududee f(x), oo eeg qaabka jaantuska
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.explain: Haddii a=3, markaas f(x)=x³+3x²+3x=(x+1)³−1. Jaantus qaabka (x+1)³ wuxuu leeyahay xagal 0 marka x=−1 laakiin wuu sii kordhaa. f'(x)=3(x+1)²≥0, bartuna kaliya halkaas oo uu yahay 0 waa x=−1.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.prompt: Qor qoraal loogu diro Soeun. Sheeg hal shay oo wanaagsan oo ku saabsan shaqada Soeun, oo sharax qaybta la hagaajinayo iyo sida, adigoo isticmaalaya tusaalaha a=3, si loo bixiyo baaxadda saxda ah ee a.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.hint.0: Marka hore hel hal shay oo Soeun si fiican u sameeyay.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.hint.1: Haddii aad qoraalka ku qorto qaabka f'(x) uu qaato marka a=3, way fududaan doontaa Soeun inuu fahmo.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma qeexday si gaar ah waxa si fiican loo sameeyay?
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma tusay safka khaldan iyo sababta adigoo isticmaalaya tusaalaha a=3?
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma qortay baaxadda saxda ah si sax ah?
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.model.0: Soeun, waxaa fiicnayd inaad qortay kala soocida! Laakiin f'(x)≥0 waa ku filan yahay, ma aha f'(x)>0. Marka a=3, f(x)=(x+1)³−1, sidaas darteed f'(x)=0 hal bar oo keliya, x=−1, shaqaduna way sii kordhaa. Sidaas darteed −3≤a≤3.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.model.1: Waxaad jawaabta u qortay −3<a<3, sax? Hubi haddii dhammaadyada a=±3 sidoo kale ay shaqeeyaan. Haddii aad geliso a=3, f(x)=(x+1)³−1, taas oo ah shaqo kordhaysa. Xitaa haddii f' uu yahay 0 hal bar, shaqadu weli way kordhaysaa ilaa calaamaddu aysan isbeddelin labada dhinac, sidaas darteed waa inaad ku darto calaamadda sinnaanta oo aad qorto −3≤a≤3.

n-m-h2-diff-10.prereq.2: Hawlaha saddex-jibbaaran ee leh isku-dhufasho tirooyin dhan
n-m-h2-diff-10.title: Ma heli karnaa qiimaha ugu badan ee deegaanka haddii aan derivative-ka oo keliya ogaano?
n-m-h2-diff-10.topic: Waxa aan ka baran karno iyo waxa aan ka baran karin macluumaadka derivative-ka: doorka ereyga joogtada ah
n-m-h2-diff-10.goal: Hubi in ogaanshaha derivative-ka oo keliya uu kuu sheegayo qaabka shaqada (halka ay kordhayso ama hoos u dhacayso iyo halka qiyamka xad-dhaafka ahi ka dhacaan) laakiin ma aha booskeeda taagan (cabbirka qiyamka xad-dhaafka ah), oo garo macluumaadka dheeraadka ah ee loo baahan yahay.
n-m-h2-diff-10.material: Derivative-ka shaqada saddex-jibbaarka f(x) waxaa la ogyahay inuu yahay f'(x)=3x²−12. Waxaan rabnaa inaan helno qiimaha ugu badan ee deegaanka ee f, laakiin ma aqaan f(x) laftiisa. (3x² waxay la macno tahay 3 jeer x laba-jibbaaran.)
n-m-h2-diff-10.thinking.0: Kala saarista waxa derivative-ku inoo sheego iyo waxa aanu inoo sheegin
n-m-h2-diff-10.thinking.2: Isticmaalka macluumaadka si loo helo qiimaha ugu badan ee deegaanka
n-m-h2-diff-10.prereq.0: Calaamadda derivative-ka iyo ugu badnaanta iyo ugu yaraanta deegaanka
n-m-h2-diff-10.prereq.1: Isku-dhafyada aan xadidnayn ee shaqooyinka polynomial-ka
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.prompt: Dooro dhammaan macluumaadka haddii aad ogaan lahayd mid ka mid ah dheeraad ahaan, aad go'aamin kartid qiimaha ugu badan ee deegaanka ee f.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.hint.0: Laga bilaabo f'(x), qor qaabka f(x) qaadayo. Ma jirtaa qayb aan la go'aamin?
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.hint.1: Hubi, doorasho mid mid, haddii ay go'aamiso qaybtaas aan la go'aamin.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.r.a: Haddii aad ogtahay hal qiime shaqo, ereyga joogtada ah waa la go'aamiyay, sidaas darteed f oo dhan waa la go'aamiyay.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.r.d: Haddii aad ogtahay hal qiime shaqo, ereyga joogtada ah waa la go'aamiyay, sidaas darteed f oo dhan waa la go'aamiyay.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.r.b: Qiimahan horeba waa la heli karaa adigoo geliya x=1 f'(x)=3x²−12, sidaas darteed ma aha macluumaad cusub.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.o.c: Qiimaha ugu yar ee f'(x) waa −12
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.r.c: Macluumaadkan sidoo kale horeba waa la heli karaa f'(x)=3x²−12 oo keliya, sidaas darteed ma aha macluumaad cusub.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.explain: Haddii f'(x)=3x²−12, markaas f(x)=x³−12x+C (C waa joogto). Isku-duubyada x ee ugu badnaanta iyo ugu yaraanta deegaanka (x=−2, 2) waa la go'aamiyay, laakiin qiimaha ugu badan ee deegaanka f(−2)=16+C waxaa la go'aamiyaa marka C la go'aamiyo oo keliya. Si loo go'aamiyo C, waxaad u baahan tahay qiime f (qiime shaqo). Macluumaadka ku saabsan derivative-ka waa isla macluumaadka aan horeba haysanno.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.prompt: Waxaa laguu bixiyay macluumaad dheeraad ah in qiimaha ugu yar ee deegaanka f uu yahay −10. Hel qiimaha ugu badan ee deegaanka f oo qor sida aad u heshay.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.hint.0: Isticmaal calaamadda derivative-ka si aad u go'aamiso qiimaha x kee ayuu ugu yaraanta deegaanku ka dhacaa.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.hint.1: Ku beddel x taas qaacidada f(x) oo deji isla'eg joogtada C.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma marka hore heshay qiyamka x halkaas oo ugu badnaanta iyo ugu yaraanta deegaanku ka dhacaan?
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma isticmaashay qiimaha ugu yar ee deegaanka si aad u go'aamiso ereyga joogtada ah?
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.model.0: Waxaan qori karnaa f(x)=x³−12x+C (C waa joogto). Ugu yaraanta deegaanku waa x=2, f(2)=C−16=−10-na, sidaas darteed C=6. Ugu badnaanta deegaanku waa x=−2, f(−2)=16+C=22.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.model.1: Isku-dhafka f' ma go'aamiyo ereyga joogtada ah, laakiin isticmaalka xaqiiqada ah in qiimaha ugu yar ee deegaanku yahay −10 wuxuu go'aamiyaa ereyga joogtada ah inuu yahay 6. Ugu badnaanta deegaanku waa x=−2, f(−2)=−8+24+6=22.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.prompt: Laba shaqo oo saddex-jibbaar ah f iyo g waxay leeyihiin isla derivative, f(0)−g(0)=6-na. Waa maxay qiimaha ugu badan ee deegaanka ee f oo laga jaray qiimaha ugu badan ee deegaanka ee g?
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.hint.0: Haddii f'=g', qor waxa dhaca marka aad farqiso f(x)−g(x).
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.hint.1: Ka fikir haddii farqigaasi la isbeddelo x ama waa joogto.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.r.a: Waxaad u malaysay in derivative-yada siman ay la macno yihiin qiyamo ugu badan oo siman. Haddii ereyada joogtada ahi kala duwan yihiin, cabbirrada qiyamka xad-dhaafka ahi sidoo kale way kala duwan yihiin.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.r.c: Waxaad laba jeer ku dartay farqiga ereyada joogtada ah. Ugu badnaanta deegaanka, farqigu wali waa 6.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.r.d: Waa la go'aamin karaa, sababtoo ah qiimaha f(0)−g(0) waa la bixiyay.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.explain: Haddii f'=g', markaas f(x)−g(x) waa joogto, f(0)−g(0)=6-na, sidaas darteed f(x)−g(x)=6 dhammaan x. Ugu badnaanta deegaanku waxay ka dhacdaa isla x labadaba, sidaas darteed farqiga qiyamka ugu badan ee deegaanka sidoo kale waa 6.

n-m-h2-diff-11.title: Samaynta aan-sinnaan run u ah x>0
n-m-h2-diff-11.topic: Caddaynta aan-sinnaanta: xadidista kala-dhexaadka iyo shuruudda sinnaanta
n-m-h2-diff-11.goal: Hel qiimaha ugu yar adigoo isticmaalaya farqinta si aad laftaada u dhisto aan-sinnaan buuxisa shuruudaha, oo sharax sababta xadidista qeexiddu u beddesho natiijada.
n-m-h2-diff-11.material: a waa tiro dhan oo togan k-na waa tiro dhan. Waxaan rabnaa inaan doorano a iyo k si aan-sinnaanta x³+k≥3a²x ay had iyo jeer run u noqoto x togan, sinnaantuna ay run u tahay x togan qaar. (3a²x waxay la macno tahay 3 jeer a laba-jibbaaran jeer x.)
n-m-h2-diff-11.thinking.0: U beddelidda aan-sinnaan shuruud ku saabsan qiimaha ugu yar ee hal shaqo
n-m-h2-diff-11.thinking.1: Abuurista kiis halkaas oo sinnaantu run tahay
n-m-h2-diff-11.thinking.2: Sharaxaadda waxa isbeddela marka kala-dhexaadku isbeddelo
n-m-h2-diff-11.prereq.0: Qiyamka xad-dhaafka ah iyo qiyamka ugu yar adigoo isticmaalaya derivative-yada
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.prompt: Haddii aan u dhigno h(x)=x³−3a²x+k, sifee ah ee h(x) x>0 ayay shuruuddani u beddeshaa?
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.hint.0: Dib u sheeg "aan-sinnaantu had iyo jeer run bay tahay" sidii hadal ku saabsan qiimaha ugu yar ee h(x).
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.hint.1: Maxay "waxaa jira x halkaas oo sinnaantu run tahay" ka sheegaysaa qiimahaas ugu yar?
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.r.a: Haddii qiimaha ugu badan uu yahay 0, markaas h(x)≤0, sidaas darteed aan-sinnaantu waxay u socotaa jihada kale.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.o.b: Qiimaha ugu yar wuu ka yar yahay 0
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.r.b: Markaas waxaa jira x leh h(x)<0, sidaas darteed aan-sinnaantu way fashilantaa.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.o.c: Qiimaha ugu yar ee h'(x) waa 0
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.r.c: Taasi waxay eegaysaa sifada h', ma aha h. Aan-sinnaantu waxay ku saabsan tahay qiyamka h.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.explain: Si h(x)≥0 had iyo jeer run u noqoto x>0, qiimaha ugu yar waa inuu noqdaa ugu yaraan 0, si ay u jirto x halkaas oo sinnaantu run tahay-na, qiimaha ugu yar waa inuu noqdaa si sax ah 0.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.prompt: Geli saddex lammaane (a, k) oo buuxiya shuruudaha, oo leh saddex qiime oo kala duwan oo a ah. (a waa tiro dhan laga bilaabo 1 ilaa 10.)
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.hint.0: Hel x togan halkaas oo h'(x)=0, oo hubi calaamadda h' labada dhinac.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.hint.1: Qor qiimaha h marka x taas ku jirta marka loo eego a iyo k, oo hel k ka dhigaya 0.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.ok.c1: a waa lambar dhan oo 1 ilaa 10, k na sidoo kale waa lambar dhan.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.fail.c1: a waa inuu noqdaa lambar dhan oo 1 ilaa 10, k na sidoo kale waa inuu noqdaa lambar dhan.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.ok.c2: Qiimaha ugu yar ee h ee x>0 waa si sax ah 0.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.fail.c2: Qiimaha ugu yar ee h(x) ee x>0 ma aha 0.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.explain: h'(x)=3x²−3a²=3(x−a)(x+a), x>0 na, h waxay ka beddelataa hoos u dhac ilaa kordhitaan x=a, sidaas darteed waxay leedahay qiimaha ugu yar h(a)=k−2a³. Haddii qiimahani yahay 0, is-sinnaan la'aantu mar walba waa run sinnaantuna waxay run tahay x=a. Sidaas darteed k=2a³.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.prompt: Hal weedh mid kasta ku sharax waxa dhaca marka k uu ka yar yahay 2a³ iyo marka uu ka weyn yahay 2a³.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.hint.0: Barbar dhig sida qiimaha h ee x=a u isbeddelo iyadoo k, adigoo u isticmaalaya k=2a³ sida tixraac.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.hint.1: Is-sinnaan la'aanta oo mar walba run ah iyo sinnaanta oo run ah waa wax kala duwan.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ma sharaxday xaaladda ka yar iyo xaaladda ka weyn si gooni gooni ah?
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ma kala saartay "mar walba run" iyo "sinnaanta run"?
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.model.0: Haddii k uu ka yar yahay 2a³, h waa taban x=a, sidaas darteed is-sinnaan la'aantu way fashilantaa. Haddii k uu ka weyn yahay 2a³, qiimaha ugu yar wuu ka weyn yahay 0, sidaas darteed is-sinnaan la'aantu waa run, laakiin x ay sinnaantu run tahay ma jirto.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.model.1: Haddii k<2a³, qiimaha ugu yar wuu ka yar yahay 0, sidaas darteed waxaa jira x is-sinnaan la'aantu aysan run ahayn. Haddii k>2a³, mar walba waa run, laakiin qiimaha ugu yar wuu ka weyn yahay 0, sidaas darteed x togan oo sinnaantu run tahay ma jirto.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.prompt: Ma jiraa lammaane (a, k) oo isla is-sinnaan la'aanta x³+k≥3a²x ay run tahay kaliya x togan ma aha laakiin dhammaan x dhab ah?
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.hint.0: Qiyaas calaamadda h(x) marka x uu yahay lambar taban oo aad u yar, sida −10 ama −100.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.hint.1: Ka fikir haddii natiijo kaliya lambarro togan la hubiyey ay si toos ah ugu fidayso lambarro taban.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.o.a: Maya. Marka x uu noqdo aad u yar (taban), dhinaca bidix wuu ka yaraadaa 3a²x
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.o.b: Haa. Iyadoo k=2a³ oo kor lagu helay, waa run x dhab ah kasta
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.r.b: Waxaad hubisay k=2a³ x>0 oo keliya mana aadan hubin haddii ay run tahay x<0. Way fashilantaa marka x uu yahay lambar taban oo aad u yar.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.o.c: Haa. Haddii aad doorato k ku filan weyn, waa run lambar dhab ah kasta
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.r.c: Marka x uu noqdo aad u yar (taban), x³ wuxuu hoos u dhacaa aad uga dhaqso badan k, sidaas darteed way fashilantaa si kasta oo aad k u weyneyso.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.o.d: Maya. Haddii aad geliso x=0, is-sinnaan la'aantu mar horeba way fashilantaa
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.r.d: Haddii x=0, waxaan u baahanahay k≥0, k=2a³>0 na, sidaas darteed waa run.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.explain: h(x)=x³−3a²x+k wuxuu aadaa −∞ marka x uu sii noqdo taban. Sidaas darteed si kasta oo aad k u doorato, waxaa jira x leh h(x)<0. Maadaama aan ku koobnay x togan, lammaane (a, k) buuxiya shuruudda ayaa jiray.

n-m-h2-explog-01.title: Hubinta xal xisaabiyey xidid labajibbaar adigoo isticmaalaya sharciyada taabbagalada
n-m-h2-explog-01.goal: Hel safka koowaad ee khaldamay ee xal isticmaalaya sharciyada taabbagalada, oo baar shuruudaha sharcigaas loo isticmaali karo si aad u hesho qiimaha saxda ah.
n-m-h2-explog-01.material: Hayun wuxuu helay qiimaha √((−3)²) isagoo isticmaalaya sharciyada taabbagalada. ((−3)² waa labajibbaarka −3, kor u qaadidda taabbagalka 1/2 na macnaheedu waa isla xididka labajibbaarka. Aan ku heshiino in taabbagal jajab lagu qeexo kaliya marka salku yahay togan.)
n-m-h2-explog-01.thinking.0: Raacitaanka xalka ilaa dhammaadka iyo helidda safka koowaad ee khaldamay
n-m-h2-explog-01.thinking.1: Barbar dhigga natiijada iyo qiimaha si toos ah loo xisaabiyey
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s1.prompt: Dooro safka koowaad ee aan sax ahayn ee xalka Hayun.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ka bilow gudaha qaansooyinka, marka hore si toos ah u xisaabi qiimaha, oo barbar dhig natiijada ugu dambeysa ee Hayun.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s1.hint.1: Mid mid u dhex mar safafka oo hubi safkee labada qiime marka hore ku kala duwanaadaan.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s1.explain: Safka 2 ayaa ah kan koowaad ee khaldamay. (a^m)^n=a^(mn) iyadoo taabbagal jajab ah waa sharci salka togan, laakiin salka −3 waa taban. Dhab ahaan, ((−3)²)^(1/2)=9^(1/2)=3. Safafka 3 iyo 4 waa xisaabo ka imaanaya safka 2.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.prompt: Qor qiimaha saxda ah, oo isticmaal calaamadda salka si aad u sharaxdo sababta safka Hayun isticmaalay sharciga taabbagalada looga isticmaali kari waayay.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore xisaabi (−3)², ka dibna qiimahaas kor u qaad taabbagalka 1/2.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.hint.1: Mar kale akhri heshiiska ku saabsan nooca lambar ee salku ahaan lahaa marka sharciga la isticmaalo.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma marka hore heshay (−3)²=9 oo ka dibna heshay qiimaha 3?
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma tiri sharciga taabbagalada waxaa la isticmaali karaa marka salku togan yahay oo keliya?
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma sheegi kartaa sababta −3 ee Hayun suurtagal u ahayn sida qiimaha xidid labajibbaar?
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.model.0: √((−3)²)=√9=3. (a^m)^n=a^(mn) ee taabbagalada jajab waxaa la isticmaali karaa kaliya marka salku togan yahay, laakiin halkan salka −3 waa taban, sidaas darteed lama isticmaali karin, isticmaalkiisa si kastaba ha ahaato na wuxuu siinayaa qiimaha khaldan −3.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.model.1: Marka hore, (−3)²=9, xididka labajibbaarka togan ee 9 na waa 3, sidaas darteed qiimuhu waa 3. Hayun wuxuu ku dabaqay sharciga inkasta oo salku yahay taban, sidaas darteed calaamaddu way ka duwanaatay.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.model.2: Jawaab: 3. Calaamadda xididka labajibbaarku waxay siisaa qiime 0 ama ka badan, sidaas darteed ma noqon karto −3. Dhibaatadu waa in sharciga taabbagalada jajab loo isticmaalay lambar leh sal taban.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.prompt: Dooro dhammaan (a, m, n) oo labada dhinac ee (a^m)^n=a^(mn) la qeexay oo leh isla qiime.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.hint.0: Doorasho kasta, si gooni gooni ah u xisaabi dhinaca bidix iyo midig, oo marka hore hubi in labaduba leeyihiin qiimayaal.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.hint.1: Haddii labaduba leeyihiin qiimayaal, barbar dhig haddii ay siman yihiin. Gooni gooni uga fikir xaaladda taabbagalku yahay lambar dhan iyo xaaladda uu yahay jajab.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.r.a: Dhinaca bidix ((−3)²)^(1/2) waa 3, dhinaca midig (−3)^1 na waa −3. Waxaa jira taabbagal jajab, sidaas darteed sharcigu ma run aha.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.r.b: Waxaad ka tagtay in taabbagallo dhan labada dhinac, sharcigu run yahay xitaa haddii salku yahay taban. Labada dhinacba waa 729.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.r.c: Waxaad ka tagtay in haddii salku yahay togan, sharcigu run yahay xitaa taabbagalo jajab. Labada dhinacba waa 25.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.r.d: Dhinaca bidix (−4)^(1/2) lama qeexin. Marka hore waa inaad hubisaa haddii labada dhinac la qeexay.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.r.e: Waxaad ka tagtay in taabbagal taban uu sidoo kale yahay taabbagal dhan, sidaas darteed sharcigu run yahay. Labada dhinacba waa 1/64.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.explain: (−3, 2, 3) wuu shaqeeyaa maadaama 9³=729=(−3)⁶, (5, 1/2, 4) wuu shaqeeyaa maadaama (√5)⁴=25=5², (−2, 3, −2) na wuu shaqeeyaa maadaama (−8)^(−2)=1/64=(−2)^(−6). Ee (−3, 2, 1/2), qiimayaashu way kala duwan yihiin, 3 iyo −3, ee (−4, 1/2, 2) na, dhinaca bidix lama qeexin. Kala saarista muhiimka ahi waa taabbagalo dhan waa la isticmaali karaa marka salku aanu ahayn 0, taabbagalo jajab na waa la isticmaali karaa marka salku togan yahay.

n-m-h2-explog-02.title: Qiimayaasha x ee laga qeexo logarithm leh xarfo salkiisa iyo doodiisa
n-m-h2-explog-02.goal: Naftaada hel qiimayaasha x ee logarithm leh x salkiisa iyo doodiisa labadaba macno u leeyahay, oo nidaamee shuruudaha mid mid si aad u hesho baaxadda x.
n-m-h2-explog-02.material: Logarithm log_a N wuxuu leeyahay qiime kaliya marka salka a iyo doodda N ay buuxiyaan shuruudo gaar ah. Markan, eeg odhaahda log_{x−1}(5−x), taasoo leh x salka iyo doodda labadaba. (Salku waa x−1 doodduna waa 5−x.)
n-m-h2-explog-02.thinking.0: Samaynta dhowr tusaale oo buuxiya shuruudaha
n-m-h2-explog-02.thinking.1: Nidaaminta sababta qiimayaasha fashilmay aan loo oggolayn
n-m-h2-explog-02.thinking.2: Isku darka shuruudaha aad heshay hal baaxad
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.prompt: Hel oo gali saddex qiime oo kala duwan oo x oo log_{x−1}(5−x) uu leeyahay qiime. (Tobanaadyo way fiican yihiin.)
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.hint.0: Geli qiime x oo qor waxa salka x−1 iyo doodda 5−x mid kasta noqdaan.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.hint.1: Hubi labadaba salka iyo doodda inay yihiin qiimayaal ay qeexidda logarithm oggoshahay. Haddii aad hesho qiime aan la oggolayn, diiwaangeli kee ayaa keenay.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.fail.c1: Salka x−1 waa 0 ama ka yar.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.fail.c2: Salka x−1 waa 1. Salku ma noqon karo 1.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.explain: Tusaale ahaan, x=3 wuxuu siinayaa log_2 2, x=4 wuxuu siinayaa log_3 1, x=1.5 na wuxuu siinayaa log_{0.5} 3.5; mid kasta, salku waa togan mana aha 1, doodduna waa togan. x=2 lama oggola sababtoo ah salku waa 1, x=0 sababtoo ah salku waa taban, x=5 na sababtoo ah doodduna waa 0.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.prompt: Dooro sababta saxda ah ee log_{x−1}(5−x) aanu qiime u lahayn marka x=2.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.hint.0: Geli x=2 salka x−1 iyo doodda 5−x oo qor qiime kasta.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.hint.1: Si gooni gooni ah u taxa qiimayaasha aan salka noqon karin iyo qiimayaasha aan dooda noqon karin, oo barbar dhig qiimayaashan.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.r.a: Waxaad ka fikirayeysay logarithm leh sal 1.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.r.b: Marka x=2, x−1 ma aha taban. Geli qiimaha oo arag.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.r.c: Marka x=2, 5−x waa 3. Geli qiimaha oo arag.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.r.d: Marka x=2, 5−x ma aha taban. Geli qiimaha oo arag.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.explain: Marka x=2, salku waa 1 doodduna waa 3. 1 oo loo kor qaaday taabbagal kasta waa 1, sidaas darteed weligeed ma noqon karto 3, taasoo la micno ah log_1 3 qiime ma laha. Taasi waa sababta salku u ahayn inuusan noqon 1.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.prompt: Qor baaxadda x ee log_{x−1}(5−x) macno u leeyahay.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.hint.0: Qor labada shuruudood ee salka iyo hal shuruudda doodda si gooni gooni ah sida is-sinnaan la'aan.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.hint.1: Sawir saddexda shuruudood xariiqda tirada, hel halka ay is dulsaaraan, oo ugu dambeyntii hubi in qiime midna aanu ka maqnayn is-dulsaarka.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma qortay labada shuruudood ee salka?
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma xusuusatay barta la reebay habka aad u muujisay baaxadda?
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.model.0: Laga bilaabo shuruudaha salka x−1>0 iyo x−1≠1, x>1 iyo x≠2. Laga bilaabo shuruudda doodda 5−x>0, x<5. Sidaas darteed 1<x<5 iyo x≠2.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.model.1: x waa inuu ka weyn yahay 1 oo ka yar 5, laakiin 2 waa in la reebo. Tani waa sababtoo ah geliddeeda 2 waxay ka dhigaysaa salka 1.

n-m-h2-explog-03.title: Sheegashada ah in 'log x²=2 log x' mar walba run tahay
n-m-h2-explog-03.goal: Baar baaxadda sifada logarithm-yada ay run tahay, hel tusaale lid ku ah sheegashada, oo saxo odhaahda ama ku dar shuruud.
n-m-h2-explog-03.material: Mina wuxuu yiri tan: "log x²=2 log x waa sifo logarithm-yada ah, sidaas darteed waa run x kasta." (log waa logarithm-ka caadiga ah.)
n-m-h2-explog-03.thinking.0: Helidda qiime ah tusaale lid ku ah
n-m-h2-explog-03.thinking.1: Barbar dhigga baaxadaha halka labada dhinac la qeexay
n-m-h2-explog-03.prereq.0: Sifada logarithm-ka log a^n=n log a
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.prompt: Dooro x ka mid ah kuwa soo socda ee muujinaya sheegashada Mina inaanay sax ahayn.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.hint.0: x kasta, si gooni gooni ah u xisaabi dhinaca bidix log x² iyo dhinaca midig 2 log x, oo marka hore hubi in labaduba leeyihiin qiimayaal.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.hint.1: Haddii labada qiime jiraan, barbar dhig haddii ay siman yihiin. Sidoo kale eeg haddii dhinac midkoodna uu qiime ma lahan.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.r.a: log 100²=4 iyo 2 log 100=4, kuwaas oo siman, sidaas darteed ma aha tusaale lid ku ah.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.r.b: Waxaad heshay xaalad halka dhinaca bidix uu leeyahay qiime laakiin dhinaca midig lama qeexin sababtoo ah doodiisu waa taban.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.r.c: Xitaa marka x uu ka yar yahay 1, log 0.01=−2 iyo 2 log 0.1=−2 waa siman yihiin. Logarithm taban wuxuu ka duwan yahay mid aan la qeexin.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.r.d: Labada dhinacba waxay le'eg yihiin 0, sidaas darteed ma aha tusaale lid ku ah.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.explain: Haddii x=−10, dhinaca bidix log (−10)²=log 100=2 wuxuu leeyahay qiime, laakiin dhinaca midig 2 log (−10) lama qeexin sababtoo ah doodiisu waa taban. Sidaas darteed ma odhan karno labada odhaah waa siman yihiin.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.prompt: Saxo odhaahda Mina, ama ku qor shuruud ku saabsan x oo ay run tahay, oo qor sababta aad sidaas u saxeyso.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.hint.0: Barbar dhig calaamadaha doodaha bidix iyo midig marka x uu yahay togan iyo marka uu yahay taban.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.hint.1: Hubi qiimaha doodda bidix x² qaadato xitaa marka x uu yahay taban, oo hel lambar togan oo midigta loo isticmaali karo halkii x.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma hubisay haddii dhinaca midig la qeexay marka x uu yahay taban?
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma hubisay hal qiime in odhaahdaada la saxay ay sidoo kale run tahay marka x uu yahay taban?
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.model.0: Waa in lagu saxaa log x²=2 log|x| (x≠0). Marka x uu yahay taban, log x lama qeexin, laakiin x² waa togan, sidaas darteed log x² waa la qeexay.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.model.1: log x²=2 log x waa run kaliya marka x>0. Marka x uu yahay taban, doodda dhinaca midig waa taban, sidaas darteed qiime ma laha.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.model.2: Marka x aanu ahayn 0, log x² = 2 log|x|. Haddii aad isticmaasho qiimaha saafiga ah, doodda mar walba waa togan.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.prompt: Dooro baaxadda x ee log (x−1)²=2 log (x−1) run tahay.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.hint.0: Hel x ee dhinaca bidix la qeexay iyo x ee dhinaca midig la qeexay.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.hint.1: X ee labada la qeexay dhexdooda, hel baaxadda halka odhaahyadu runtii siinayaan isla qiime.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.r.a: Waxay sidoo kale daboolaysaa baaxadda halka dhinaca midig la qeexay.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.o.b: Dhammaan tirooyinka dhabta ah marka laga reebo 1
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.r.b: Dhinaca bidix waa la qeexay ee x≠1, laakiin dhinaca midig lama qeexin ee x<1.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.r.c: Marka x=1, labada dhinacba lama qeexin.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.r.d: Haddii x<1, doodda x−1 ee dhinaca midig waa taban, sidaas darteed lama qeexin.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.explain: Dhinaca midig 2 log (x−1) waa la qeexay kaliya marka x−1>0, taasi waa, x>1, xaaladdaas na wuxuu le'eg yahay dhinaca bidix. Ee x<1 dhinaca midig ma jiro, sidaas darteed ma odhan karno waa siman yihiin.

n-m-h2-explog-04.title: Kee ayaa ka weyn, log₂3 mise log₃4?
n-m-h2-explog-04.goal: Saxo xukunkaaga ku saabsan cabbirka logarithm-yada marka aad hesho macluumaad dheeraad ah, oo barbar dhig labada logarithm adigoon xisaabiye isticmaalin adigoo isticmaalaya calaamad dhexe.
n-m-h2-explog-04.material: Adigoon xisaabiye isticmaalin, waxaan rabnaa inaan ogaano kee ka weyn, log_2 3 mise log_3 4. Macluumaadka waxaa la muujiyaa hal-hal. (log_2 3 waa logarithm-ka 3 ee leh sal 2.)
n-m-h2-explog-04.thinking.1: Beddelidda xukunkaaga iyadoo loo eegayo macluumaad cusub
n-m-h2-explog-04.thinking.2: Barbar dhigga adigoo isticmaalaya calaamad dhexe
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.prompt: Tallaabo kasta, dooro xukun ku salaysan waxa aad hadda taqaan oo keliya.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.hint.0: Mar kasta oo macluumaad cusub soo baxo, ka fikir inaad xukunkaaga ilaaliso mise beddesho.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.hint.1: Marka salka iyo doodda labaduba kala duwan yihiin, ka fikir haddii ay wanaagsan tahay in lagu xukumo mid ka mid ah oo keliya.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.info: log_2 3 waa x buuxinaya 2^x=3, log_3 4 na waa x buuxinaya 3^x=4. Maadaama 2<3<4, log_2 3 wuxuu u dhexeeyaa 1 iyo 2, maadaama 3<4<9, log_3 4 sidoo kale wuxuu u dhexeeyaa 1 iyo 2.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kee ayaad u malaynaysaa inuu weyn yahay?
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Ogaanshaha oo keliya in labaduba u dhexeeyaan 1 iyo 2 ma na ogolaanayo inaan go'aamino kala horreynta. Waxaan u baahanahay halbeeg dhexe oo ka sax badan.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: log_2 3: salku wuu yar yahay, sidaas darteed waxay u badan tahay inuu u baahan yahay jibbaar weyn si uu u gaaro 3
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Waxaad isticmaashay dareenka ah marka salku yaryahay jibbaarku waa inuu weynaadaa. Waa tallaabo hore, laakiin lama xaqiijin.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: log_3 4: doodda 4 waa ka weyn tahay 3, sidaas darteed waxay u badan tahay in logarithm-ku weyn yahay
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Waxaad eegtay doodda oo keliya. Waxaad seegtay in salku sidoo kale is beddelo.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Weli lama hubo: waxaan ognahay oo keliya in labaduba u dhexeeyaan 1 iyo 2
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Kani waa xukunka ah halbeeg ka sax badan ayaa loo baahan yahay.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Aan ku cabbirno halbeegga dhexe 3/2. 2^(3/2)=√8≈2.83 wuu ka yar yahay 3, sidaas darteed log_2 3 wuu ka weyn yahay 3/2. 3^(3/2)=√27≈5.20 wuu ka weyn yahay 4, sidaas darteed log_3 4 wuu ka yar yahay 3/2.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Hadda kee ayaad ku xukuntaa inuu weyn yahay?
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Waxaad xukuntay ka soo horjeeda macluumaadka cusub. Mar kale eeg kee ayaa ka weyn 3/2.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Waxaad kala saartay labada qiime adigoo 3/2 dhex dhigay.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Labada qiime waxay ku jiraan dhinacyo kala duwan oo 3/2, sidaas darteed siman ma noqon karaan.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Si isku mid ah u qiyaas, log_2 3≈1.585, log_3 4≈1.262, log_4 5≈1.161, iyo log_5 6≈1.113.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Sidee ayuu log_n(n+1) u is beddelaa marka n weynaado?
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Maadaama n+1>n, log_n(n+1) had iyo jeer wuu ka weyn yahay 1, qiimihiisuna wuu yaraadaa wuxuuna u dhowaadaa 1.

n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Waxaad eegtay doodda oo keliya. Salku sidoo kale wuu weynaanayaa.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Wuu yaraadaa, laakiin marna ma dhaco ka hooseeya 1
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Waxaad eegtay jihada qiimayaasha iyo xaqiiqda ah doodda ayaa ka weyn salka.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Wuu yaraadaa wuxuuna ugu dambeyntii ka hoos dhacaa 1
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Haddii doodda ay ka weyn tahay salka, logarithm-ku had iyo jeer wuu ka weyn yahay 1.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.reflect: Bilowga ma go'aamin karnay sababtoo ah labaduba waxay u dhexeeyaan 1 iyo 2, laakiin marka aan geliyay halbeegga dhexe 3/2, kala horreyntii way go'aantay. Marka laba tiro ay u muuqdaan kuwo kala duwan, hel tiro tixraac ah oo laga dhigi karo dhexdooda oo mid kasta ku barbar dhig.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.prompt: Muuji, adigoo isticmaalaya 3/2 oo aan xisaabiye isticmaalin, in log_2 3>log_3 4.

n-m-h2-explog-06.title: Naqshadaynta shaqo jibbaar ah y=aˣ+b si ay ula jaan qaado shuruudaha la bixiyay
n-m-h2-explog-06.goal: Naftaada u naqshadee shaqo jibbaar ah oo garaafkeedu maro bar oo la kulmo dhidibka x, oo xukun shuruudaha adigoo isticmaalaya meesha asymptote-ka iyo x-jarista.
n-m-h2-explog-06.material: Aan naqshadayno garaafka y=a^x+b (a waa tiro dabiici ah oo ka mid ah 2 ilaa 10, b-na waa tiro dhan). Waxaan ku xukumaynaa qaacidada iyo shuruudaha oo keliya, sawir la'aan.
n-m-h2-explog-06.thinking.0: Naftaada u samaynta qaacido buuxisa shuruudaha
n-m-h2-explog-06.thinking.1: Helidda tusaale maraya barta laakiin jebiya shuruud kale
n-m-h2-explog-06.thinking.2: Habaynta xiriirka u dhexeeya asymptote-ka iyo x-jarista
n-m-h2-explog-06.prereq.0: Garaafka iyo asymptote-ka shaqada jibbaarka y=a^x
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.prompt: Gali laba lammaane oo kala duwan (a, b) si garaafka y=a^x+b uu maro barta (2, 7) oo uu la kulmo dhidibka x.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.hint.0: Qor shuruudda maraya barta (2, 7) sida isla'eg oo hel xiriirka u dhexeeya a iyo b.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.hint.1: Dooro a, hel b, kadibna hubi haddii garaafkaasi la kulmo dhidibka x. Haddii kale, beddel a.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.ok.c1: a waa tiro dabiici ah oo ka mid ah 2 ilaa 10.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.fail.c1: a waa inuu noqdaa tiro dabiici ah oo ka mid ah 2 ilaa 10.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.fail.c2: b waa inuu noqdaa tiro dhan.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.ok.c4: Asymptote-ka y=b wuxuu ka hooseeyaa dhidibka x, sidaas darteed garaafku wuxuu la kulmaa dhidibka x.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.fail.c4: Garaafku ma la kulmo dhidibka x. Hubi meesha asymptote-ka y=b iyo garaafka.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.explain: Laga bilaabo a²+b=7, b=7−a². Tusaale ahaan, a=3 wuxuu siinayaa b=−2 a=4 na wuxuu siinayaa b=−9; marka b<0, asymptote-ka y=b wuxuu ka hooseeyaa dhidibka x, sidaas darteed garaafku wuxuu la kulmaa dhidibka x. a=2, b=3, sidaas darteed garaafku wuxuu maraa barta (2, 7) laakiin wuxuu ku yaalaa kor y=3 oo keliya.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.prompt: Garaafka lagu sameeyay a=2, b=3 wuxuu maraa barta (2, 7) laakiin ma buuxiyo shuruudaha. Qor sababta.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.hint.0: Eeg asymptote-ka garaafkan iyo haddii garaafku ka sarreeyo ama ka hooseeyo.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.hint.1: Hel xadka qiimayaasha y=2^x+3 qaadan karo, laga bilaabo xadka 2^x.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.selfAssess.0: Ma sheegtay in qiimaha y uu had iyo jeer ka weyn yahay 3?
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.selfAssess.1: Ma sheegtay in, sidaas darteed, y aanay noqon karin 0?
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.model.0: 2^x had iyo jeer waa togan yahay, sidaas darteed 2^x+3 had iyo jeer wuu ka weyn yahay 3. Sidaas darteed y ma noqon karo 0, garaafkuna ma la kulmo dhidibka x.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.model.1: Asymptote-ka garaafkan waa y=3, garaafkuna wuxuu ku yaalaa kor isaga oo keliya. Sidaas darteed ma la kulmo dhidibka x.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.model.2: y=2^x+3 had iyo jeer wuxuu qaadanayaa qiimayaal ka weyn 3, sidaas darteed marna ma gaaro dhidibka x.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.prompt: a>1, dooro shuruudda b si garaafka y=a^x+b uu la kulmo dhidibka x.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore qor xadka a^x, kadibna hel xadka y noqdo marka aad ku darto b.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.hint.1: Ka fikir b waa inuu noqdaa maxay si 0 uu ugu jiro xadkaas dhexdiisa.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.r.a: Haddii b=0, markaas y=a^x, kaas oo had iyo jeer togan, sidaas darteed ma la kulmo dhidibka x.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.r.b: Haddii b togan yahay, garaafku wuxuu ka sarreeyaa b, sidaas darteed ma la kulmo dhidibka x.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.r.c: Waxay sidoo kale ka kooban tahay kiiska b togan yahay. Hubi kiiska asymptote-ku ka sarreeyo dhidibka x.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.r.d: Waxaad ogtahay in qiimayaasha y=a^x+b dhammaantood ay yihiin qiimayaal ka weyn b, sidaas darteed b waa inuu noqdaa taban si 0 loogu daro.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.explain: Qiimayaasha a^x waa dhammaan tirooyinka run ah ee ka weyn 0, sidaas darteed qiimayaasha a^x+b waa dhammaan tirooyinka run ah ee ka weyn b. Si 0 ugu jiro xadkan, b<0 ayaa loo baahan yahay. Tani macnaheedu waa asymptote-ka y=b wuxuu ka hooseeyaa dhidibka x.

n-m-h2-explog-08.material: Seoyeon wuxuu isticmaalay logarithm-yada caadiga ah si uu u helo imisa god-lambar ayuu 3^50 leeyahay. (log 3=0.4771, 3^50 na waa 3 taabbagalka 50aad.)
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s1.prompt: Dooro safka koowaad ee khaldan ee xalka Seoyeon.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s1.hint.0: Hubi lambar ka yar. Imisa god-lambar ayuu 10^2=100 leeyahay?

n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.hint.0: Qor tirada god-lambarrada 10^1, 10^2, 10^3 oo hel farqiga u dhexeeya taabbagalka iyo tirada god-lambarrada.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.hint.1: Ku dabaq qaabka aad heshay N leh log N=23.855.

n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s3.prompt: Tirooyinka togan N ee logarithm-yadooda caadiga ah hoos lagu bixiyey dhexdooda, dooro dhammaan kuwa leh 8 god-lambar.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s3.hint.0: Qor N kasta sida baaxad u dhexeysa taabbagalada 10. Tusaale ahaan, haddii log N=7.2, labada taabbagal kee dhexdooda ayuu ku jiraa?

n-m-h2-explog-10.title: Helidda lammaanayaasha togan ee log(a+b)=log a+log b run yahay
n-m-h2-explog-10.goal: Hubi adigoo dhisaya tusaalayaal haddii xaqiiqda guud ee "logarithm-ka wadarta ma aha wadarta logarithm-yada" ay leedahay ka reeban, oo nidaamee shuruudda sida qaacidada.
n-m-h2-explog-10.material: log(a+b)=log a+log b waa isla'eg badanaa run ahayn. Laakiin tirooyin togan a iyo b dhexdooda, ma jiraa lammaane run ah? (log waa logarithm-ka caadiga ah.)
n-m-h2-explog-10.thinking.1: U beddelidda wadarta logarithm-yada logarithm wax-isku-dhufasho
n-m-h2-explog-10.prereq.0: Sifada logarithm-yada log a+log b=log ab
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.prompt: Gali saddex lammaane oo kala duwan oo tirooyin togan a, b oo log(a+b)=log a+log b run yahay. (Lammaane a iyo b la is-beddelay waxaa loo tiriyaa isla lammaane. Tobanaadyo way fiican yihiin.)
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.hint.0: Isku dar wadarta logarithm-yada midigta hal logarithm oo barbar dhig dhinaca bidix.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.hint.1: Qor waxa doodduhu tahay inay noqdaan haddii labada logarithm ay siman yihiin, kadibna dooro a oo hel b.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.ok.c1: a iyo b labaduba waa togan yihiin.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.fail.c1: a iyo b labaduba waa inay noqdaan togan.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.ok.c2: a+b iyo ab waa siman yihiin, sidaas darteed log(a+b)=log a+log b waa run.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.fail.c2: a+b iyo ab waa kala duwan yihiin, sidaas darteed labada logarithm ma siman yihiin.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.explain: Maadaama log a+log b=log ab, isla'egtu waa run marka log(a+b)=log ab, taasi waa, marka a+b=ab. (2, 2), (3, 1.5), iyo (5, 1.25) dhammaantood way shaqeeyaan. Waxaan isticmaalnay xaqiiqda ah laba logarithm waa siman yihiin kaliya haddii doodahoodu siman yihiin.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.prompt: Qor sida qaacidada xiriirka u dhexeeya a iyo b ee ku jira lammaanayaasha aad heshay, oo qor sababta xiriirkaasi labada odhaah u ka dhigayo kuwo siman.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.hint.0: Lammaane kasta oo aad heshay, xisaabi a+b iyo ab oo dhinac dhinac u qor.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.hint.1: Isku dar log a+log b hal logarithm oo qor waxa doodda tahay.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.selfAssess.0: Ma qortay log a+log b=log ab?
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.selfAssess.1: Ma tiri haddii logarithm-yadu siman yihiin, doodaha waa siman yihiin?
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.model.0: Maadaama log a+log b=log ab, si log(a+b)=log ab loo helo waxaan u baahanahay a+b=ab. Tani waa sababtoo ah haddii laba logarithm ay siman yihiin, doodahoodu waa siman yihiin.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.model.1: Wadarta iyo wax-isku-dhufashada a iyo b waa inay siman yihiin (ab=a+b). Tani waa sababtoo ah wadarta logarithm-yada waxay le'eg tahay logarithm-ka wax-isku-dhufashada doodaha, haddii logarithm-yadu siman yihiin na, doodahoodu waa siman yihiin.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.model.2: Way ku filan tahay (a−1)(b−1)=1. Ballaadhinta waxay siinaysaa ab−a−b+1=1, sidaas darteed ab=a+b, iyo log a+log b=log ab=log(a+b).
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.prompt: Dooro hadalka sax ah ee ku saabsan tirooyin togan a, b oo log(a+b)=log a+log b run yahay.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.hint.0: Haddii a uu yahay ugu badnaan 1, ka dhig b togan oo barbar dhig kee ka weyn ab ama a+b.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.hint.1: Lammaanayaasha buuxiya a+b=ab dhexdooda, barbar dhig cabbirrada a iyo b midba midka kale.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.o.a: Mid ka mid ah a iyo b wuxuu noqon karaa ka yar 1
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.r.a: Haddii a≤1, markaas ab≤b<a+b, sidaas darteed a+b ma le'eg noqon karo ab.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.o.b: a iyo b labaduba way ka weyn yihiin 1
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.r.b: Waxaad ogtahay in haddii a≤1 ama b≤1, wax-isku-dhufashadu wuxuu noqdaa ka yar wadarta, sidaas darteed ma siman karaan.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.o.c: a iyo b labaduba way ka yar yihiin 1
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.r.c: Haddii labaduba ka yar yihiin 1, wax-isku-dhufashadu aad buu uga yar yahay wadarta.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.o.d: Mid ka mid ah a iyo b waa inuu noqdaa 2
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.r.d: Waxaa jira lammaanayaal aan lahayn 2, sida (3, 1.5).
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.explain: Haddii a≤1, markaas ab≤b<a+b, sidaas darteed a+b ma le'eg noqon karo ab. Isla arrintaas waa run marka b≤1. Sidaas darteed lammaanayaasha shaqeeya, a iyo b labaduba way ka weyn yihiin 1. Maadaama (a−1)(b−1)=1, marka mid ku dhowaado 1, kan kale wuu sii weynaadaa.

n-m-h2-limit-01.title: Maxaan u baahanahay inaan ogaano si aan u odhanno shaqo waa joogto?
n-m-h2-limit-01.topic: Xadka iyo joogtonimada shaqooyinka: shuruudaha joogtonimada
n-m-h2-limit-01.goal: Kala sooc macluumaadka lagama maarmaanka ah iyo ku filan si loo gabagabeeyo in shaqo ay joogto tahay x=a, naftaada go'aami haddii shaqo joogto tahay, oo nidaamee heerkaas erayadaada.
n-m-h2-limit-01.material: Waxaan rabnaa inaan ogaano haddii shaqo f ay joogto tahay x=1. Xadka bidix waa qiimaha f(x) ku dhowaado marka x uu ku dhowaado 1 dhinaca halka x ka yar yahay 1, xadka midig na waa qiimaha ay ku dhowaato dhinaca halka x ka weyn yahay 1. Ka fikir haddii aan gabagabeyn karno "waa joogto" marka aan ogaanno qayb macluumaadka ka mid ah oo keliya.
n-m-h2-limit-01.thinking.0: Kala saarista macluumaadka noo oggolaanaya inaan gabagabeyno iyo macluumaadka ka gaabta
n-m-h2-limit-01.thinking.1: Baaritaanka xiriirada u dhexeeya qiimaha shaqada, xadka bidix, iyo xadka midig
n-m-h2-limit-01.prereq.1: Khibrad kala saarista qiimayaasha shaqada iyo qiimayaasha xadka
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.prompt: Dooro hal macluumaad, kuwa soo socda ee ku saabsan f dhexdooda, kaas oo kuu oggolaanaya inaad hubto f inay joogto tahay x=1 marka aad ogtahay macluumaadkaas oo keliya.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.hint.0: Marka hore taxa waxa aad hubin leedahay si aad u odhato waa joogto, ka dibna calaamadee haddii doorasho kastaa buuxiso dhammaan.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kala sooc "qiimaha waa la qeexay" iyo "qiimahaasi wuxuu le'eg yahay qiimaha xadka" sida macluumaad kala duwan.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.o.a: f(1)=3, f(x) na wuxuu u dhowaadaa 3 marka x uu u dhowaado 1 dhinaca weyn
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad eegtay hal xad dhinac keliya. Weli ma ogaan qiimaha marka laga soo dhowaado dhinaca kale.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.o.b: f(1)=3, xadka bidix iyo midig labaduba way jiraan oo midba midka kale wuu le'eg yahay
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.r.b: Waad ogtahay in xadku jiro, laakiin ma ogaan kartid haddii qiimaha xadkaasi le'eg yahay f(1)=3.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.o.c: f(1)=3, xadka bidix iyo midig labaduba waa 3
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.o.d: Xadka bidix iyo midig labaduba waa 3, f(1) na waxaa loo qeexay qiime
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.r.d: Adigoo ogaanaya f(1) la qeexay oo keliya, ma ogaan kartid haddii qiimahaasi yahay 3.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.explain: Si ay u noqoto joogto, f(1) waa inuu qeexan yahay, xadka marka x→1 waa inuu jiraa, qiimahaas xadka na waa inuu le'eg yahay f(1). Doorashada c waxay buuxisaa saddexda oo dhan. Doorashada a waxay leedahay hal xad dhinac keliya, b ma xidho xadka iyo f(1), d na ma ogayn qiimaha f(1), sidaas darteed ma ogaan karno haddii uu le'eg yahay qiimaha xadka.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.prompt: Dooro dhammaan afartan shaqo ee kuwa joogto ah x=1.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.hint.0: Shaqo kasta, hel si isku xigta qiimaha shaqada x=1, xadka bidix, iyo xadka midig, oo ku nidaamee jadwal.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.hint.1: Odhaah jajab ah, fududee ee x≠1, ka dibna hel qiimaha marka x uu u dhowaado 1.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.r.b: Marka x→1, (x²−1)/(x−1)=x+1 wuxuu u dhowaadaa 2, laakiin f₂(1)=1, sidaas darteed qiimaha xadka iyo qiimaha shaqada way kala duwan yihiin.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.r.c: Haddii qiime shaqo x=1 uusan jirin, ma odhan karno waa joogto xitaa haddii xadku jiro.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.explain: f₁ wuxuu le'eg yahay x+1 ee x≠1, sidaas darteed xadkiisu waa 2, f₁(1)=2 na waa waafaqsan yahay. Ee f₄, xadka bidix waa 2, xadka midig waa 3·1−1=2, f₄(1)=2 na, sidaas darteed dhammaantood waa siman yihiin. Ee f₂, qiimaha xadka 2 iyo qiimaha shaqada 1 way kala duwan yihiin, f₃ na ma laha f₃(1).
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.prompt: Gudaha s2, shaqooyinka aan joogtada ahayn waa laga saaray sababo kala duwan awgood. Erayadaada, nidaamee waxa aad hubin leedahay si aad u odhato shaqo waa joogto x=a.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.hint.0: Mar kale qor shayga f₂ iyo f₃ midba laga saaray.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.hint.1: Haddii sababaha la diiday ay kala duwan yihiin, tiri imisa wax ayaad u baahan tahay inaad hubiso si aad dhammaantood u saarto.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma sheegtay saddexda shuruudood oo dhan adigoon midna ka tagin?
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Shuruudahaagu ma ku jiraan sababaha f₂ iyo f₃ la diiday?
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.model.0: f waa joogto x=a haddii f(a) la qeexay, xadku wuu jiraa sababtoo ah xadka bidix iyo midig way siman yihiin marka x→a, xadkaasna wuxuu le'eg yahay f(a).
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.model.1: Marka hore, qiimaha shaqada waa inuu jiraa. Marka labaad, xadku waa inuu jiraa, taasi waxay la micno tahay xadka labada dhinac way siman yihiin. Marka saddexaad, xadkaasi waa inuu le'eg yahay qiimaha shaqada.

n-m-h2-limit-02.title: Hubinta sheegasho ah in xidid jiro iyadoo la adeegsanayo Aragtida Qiimaha Dhexe
n-m-h2-limit-02.topic: Xadka iyo joogtonimada shaqooyinka: Aragtida Qiimaha Dhexe
n-m-h2-limit-02.goal: Marka la isticmaalayo Aragtida Qiimaha Dhexe, ha eegin calaamadaha oo keliya: hubi in shuruudaha aragtidu la buuxiyey, oo ku muuji tusaale lid ku ah in sheegashadu been tahay.
n-m-h2-limit-02.material: Seojin wuxuu rabay inuu ogaado haddii isla'egta 1/x=0 ay leedahay xidid dhab ah dhexda (−1, 2), sidaas darteed wuxuu dhigay f(x)=1/x wuxuuna u shaqeeyey sidan.
n-m-h2-limit-02.thinking.0: Hubinta malo-awaalka ka hor isticmaalka aragti
n-m-h2-limit-02.thinking.1: Helidda safka halka shuruud aragtideed maqan tahay
n-m-h2-limit-02.thinking.2: Doorashada hab lagu buuxiyo shuruudda maqan
n-m-h2-limit-02.prereq.0: Shaqooyinka joogtada ah iyo bayaanka Aragtida Qiimaha Dhexe
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.prompt: Dooro safka koowaad ee aan sax ahayn ee xalka Seojin.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.hint.0: Saf kasta u kala sooc "xisaab" ama "xukun ku dabaqaya aragtida."
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.hint.1: Safka ku dabaqaya aragtida, barbar dhig shuruudaha aragtidu u baahan tahay iyo waxa la hubiyey, mid mid.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.line.0: Ha noqoto f(x)=1/x. Markaas f(−1)=−1 iyo f(2)=1/2.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.line.2: Marka loo eego Aragtida Qiimaha Dhexe, waxaa jira c inta u dhexeysa −1 iyo 2 oo leh f(c)=0.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.line.3: Sidaas darteed isla'egta 1/x=0 waxay leedahay xidid dhab ah kala-dhexaadka (−1, 2).
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.explain: Safka 3 waa khaladka ugu horreeya. Aragtida Qiimaha Dhexe waxaa la isticmaali karaa marka f uu joogto yahay kala-dhexaadka xidhan [−1, 2] oo keliya, laakiin f(x)=1/x lama qeexin x=0, taas oo ku jirta kala-dhexaadkan. Xisaabaha safafka 1 iyo 2 waa sax, safka 4-na wuxuu kaliya raacaa gabagabada khaldan ee safka 3.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.prompt: Muuji in gabagabada Seojin ay khalad tahay. Qor shuruudda ay shaqada tahay inay buuxiso si Aragtida Qiimaha Dhexe loo isticmaalo, sababta f(x)=1/x aysan u buuxin, iyo waa maxay xididada dhabta ah ee 1/x=0.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.hint.0: Qor aragtida qaabka "haddii ..., markaas ..." oo tiri immisa shuruudood ayaa "haddii" ka dambeeya.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.hint.1: Hubi haddii qeexidda f(x)=1/x ay ka maqan tahay bar inta u dhexeysa −1 iyo 2.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma marka hore qortay shuruudda aragtida (joogtayn)?
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma tilmaantay in x=0 ay ku jirto kala-dhexaadka?
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.model.0: Aragtida Qiimaha Dhexe waxaa la isticmaali karaa marka f uu joogto yahay [−1, 2] oo keliya. Laakiin f(x)=1/x lama qeexin x=0, sidaas darteed ma joogto. Dhab ahaan, x ma jiro oo buuxiya 1/x=0, sidaas darteed xidid dhab ah ma jiro.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.model.1: Si aragtida loo isticmaalo, shaqadu waa inay joogto noqotaa kala-dhexaadka, laakiin 1/x wuu jabaa x=0, sidaas darteed lama isticmaali karo. Maadaama soo-qaybiyuhu yahay 1, x ma jiro oo 1/x ka dhigaya 0, sidaas darteed isla'egtani xal ma laha.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.prompt: Ku hay f(−1)<0<f(2) sida ay tahay. Dooro shuruudda lagu daro si hubaal loogu gabagabeeyo in f(x)=0 uu leeyahay xidid kala-dhexaadka (−1, 2).
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.hint.0: Qiyaas haddii jaantus bood leh ama jab leh kala-dhexaadka gudihiisa uu ka booday 0 isagoo aan ka gudbin.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.hint.1: Go'aami haddii doorasho kasta ay ku saabsan tahay dhammaadyada ama kala-dhexaadka oo dhan.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.o.a: f waa joogto x=−1 iyo x=2
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.r.a: Xitaa haddii f uu joogto yahay labada dhammaad oo keliya, jab dhexda kala-dhexaadka ah ayaa kuu keeni karta inaad xidid seegto.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.o.b: f(−1) iyo f(2) labaduba waa tirooyin dhan
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.r.b: Haddii qiyamku yihiin tirooyin dhan waxba kuma laha in xidid jiro.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.o.c: f waa joogto barta kasta ee kala-dhexaadka xidhan [−1, 2]
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.o.d: f(x) ma aha eber x kasta oo kala-dhexaadka (−1, 2) ah
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.r.d: Tani waxay la macno tahay xidid ma jiro, sidaas darteed runtii waxay ka hor imanaysaa gabagabada.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.explain: Aragtida Qiimaha Dhexe waxay u baahan tahay joogtayn dhammaan kala-dhexaadka xidhan. Shuruuddan, 0 waa inay dhacdaa inta u dhexeysa qiyamka dhammaadka ee calaamado is-diidan leh.

n-m-h2-limit-04.title: Xadka shaqo isku-dhafan: baarista sheegashada Mina
n-m-h2-limit-04.topic: Xadka iyo joogtaynta shaqooyinka: xadka shaqo isku-dhafan
n-m-h2-limit-04.goal: Adigoo isticmaalaya tusaale, xaqiiji in xadka shaqo isku-dhafan uu isbeddelo iyadoo ku xidhan dhinaca shaqada gudaha ay u dhowaato 0, oo sharax haddii sheegashadu run tahay ama been tahay, adigoo bixinaya sababo.
n-m-h2-limit-04.material: Qeex shaqada f sida f(t)=1 (t>0), f(0)=0, f(t)=−1 (t<0). Marka t→0, xadka bidix −1 iyo xadka midig 1 way kala duwan yihiin, sidaas darteed xadka f ma jiro. Ka soo qaad shaqada g oo u dhowaata 0 marka x→0. Mina wuxuu leeyahay, "Markaas xadka shaqada isku-dhafan f(g(x)) marka x→0 sidoo kale ma jiro." (Tixgeli x oo leh g(x)≠0 oo keliya.)
n-m-h2-limit-04.thinking.1: Qeexidda xaaladda u dhowaanshaha hal dhinac
n-m-h2-limit-04.thinking.2: Kala saarista waxa la eego marka la go'aaminayo haddii xad jiro
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.prompt: Dooro dhammaan doorashooyinka g(x) ee soo socda ee xadka f(g(x)) marka x→0 jiro.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.hint.0: Ku beddel x 0.1, −0.1, 0.01, −0.01 oo eeg calaamadda g(x).
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.hint.1: Marka calaamadda g(x) la go'aamiyo, hubi haddii qiimaha f(g(x)) la go'aamiyay sidii hal qiime.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.r.b: Haddii x>0 markaas g>0, haddii x<0-na markaas g<0, sidaas darteed f(g(x)) wuxuu is-beddelaa 1 iyo −1.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.r.d: Calaamadda g waxay la isbeddeshaa calaamadda x, sidaas darteed f(g(x)) wuxuu is-beddelaa 1 iyo −1.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.explain: g(x)=x² (x≠0) had iyo jeer waa togan, sidaas darteed f(g(x))=1 xaduna waa 1. g(x)=−x⁴ (x≠0) had iyo jeer waa taban, sidaas darteed f(g(x))=−1 xaduna waa −1. x³ iyo 2x calaamaddu way isbeddeshaa, sidaas darteed xad ma jiro.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s2.prompt: Ma sheegashada Mina had iyo jeer waa run? Go'aami haddii ay run tahay iyo in kale, oo sharax sababta adigoo ku xidhaya sida g(x) ugu dhowaato 0.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s2.hint.0: Dhig g ka s1 oo lahaa xad agtiisa g aan lahayn, oo barbar dhig sida calaamadda g(x) u kala duwanayd.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s2.hint.1: Ka fikir haddii cabbirka t ama sifada t ay go'aamiso qiimaha f(t).
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma bixisay hal g(x) oo gaar ah?
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma ku xidhay dhinaca ay ku dhowaanayso 0 iyo qiimaha f?
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s2.model.0: Sheegashada Mina had iyo jeer run ma aha. Haddii g(x)=x², markaas g(x) wuxuu u dhowaadaa 0 dhinaca togan oo keliya, sidaas darteed f(g(x)) wuxuu sii ahaanayaa 1 xaduna wuu jiraa wuxuuna la mid yahay 1.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s2.model.1: Maya. Haddii g(x) uu u dhowaado 0 dhinaca taban oo keliya, markaas f(g(x))=−1 waa joogto, sidaas darteed xaduna wuu jiraa, g(x)=−x⁴-na waa tusaale lid ku ah.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.prompt: Si loo ogaado haddii xadka f(g(x)) marka x→0 jiro, maxaad baaraysaa?
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.hint.0: Marka x u dhowaado 0, qor qiyamka gelinta g(x) ee f qaadato 0 agtiisa.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.hint.1: Kala saar qiyamkaas kuwa dhinaca xadka bidix ee f iyo kuwa dhinaca xadka midig.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.o.a: Haddii xadka bidix iyo midig ee f(t) marka t→0 ay u dhowaadaan hal qiime oo isku mid ah
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.r.a: Eegitaankan oo keliya wuxuu keenaa isla gabagabada Mina. Ma eego dhinaca ay shaqada gudaha ugu dhowaato.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.o.b: Haddii f(0) iyo g(0) ay siman yihiin, iyo haddii labaduba la qeexay
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.r.b: Qiimaha x=0 looma isticmaalo helista xadka marka x→0.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.o.c: Sida degdegga ah ee g(x) u isbeddelo marka x u dhowaado 0, iyo cabbirkiisa
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.r.c: Xawaaruhu waxba kuma laha haddii xad jiro.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.o.d: Calaamadda qiyamka g(x) qaadato 0 agtiisa, iyo qiimaha f calaamaddaas
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.explain: Qiimaha f(g(x)) waxaa go'aamiya dhinaca qiyamka g(x) ay ku yaalaan 0 agtiisa. Haddii g(x) uu u dhowaado hal dhinac oo keliya, waxaad u baahan tahay xadka dhinacaas. Haddii uu u dhowaado labada dhinacba, waa inaad barbar dhigtaa xadka bidix iyo midig.
