n-m-h2-integ-07.title: Haddii kala-duwaha joogto uu yahay 0, k sidoo kale ma 0 baa?
n-m-h2-integ-07.topic: Qiimaha isku-dhejinta cayiman waa joogto: isla'egyada shaqo ee ka kooban isku-dhejin cayiman
n-m-h2-integ-07.goal: Fahan in isku-dhejinta cayiman ∫₀¹ f(t)dt ay tahay joogto aan la xidhiidhin x laakiin qiimaheedu aanu ahayn 0 oo waa in laga xisaabiyaa qeexidda, oo qor sharaxaad naxariis leh arday yar oo sameeyay isla qaladkaas.
n-m-h2-integ-07.material: Kani waa xalka Haeun ee helista shaqada f(x) buuxinaysa shuruudda f(x)=x²+2∫₀¹ f(t)dt. (∫₀¹ waa isku-dhejinta cayiman laga bilaabo 0 ilaa 1.)
n-m-h2-integ-07.thinking.2: Sharaxidda qalad iyadoo la ixtiraamayo xalka qofka kale
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s1.prompt: Dooro safka ugu horreeya ee khaldan xalka Haeun.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s1.hint.0: Hubi haddii saf kasta runtii uga soo baxayo kii ka horreeyay, iyo haddii saf kasta uu leeyahay sabab ku filan.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s1.hint.1: Dib u gal sida k loo qeexay, oo ka fikir waxa dhaca haddii aad geliso f(x) ee ugu dambeyntii la helay qeexiddaas.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s1.line.0: ∫₀¹ f(t)dt waa qiime aan x ku jirin, sidaas darteed ka dhig k, f(x)=x²+2k.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s1.line.1: Kala-duwidda labada dhinac marka loo eego x waxay siinaysaa f'(x)=2x, sidaas darteed k wuu baxaa marka la kala-duwo.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s1.line.2: k waa joogto, kala-duwaha joogtona waa 0, sidaas darteed k=0.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s1.explain: Safka 3 waa kan ugu horreeya ee khaldan. Waa run in kala-duwaha joogto uu yahay 0, laakiin taasi macnaheedu ma aha in qiimaha joogtadu yahay 0. Qiimaha k waa in laga go'aamiyaa qeexidda k=∫₀¹ f(t)dt. Gelinta f(t)=t²+2k waxay siinaysaa k=∫₀¹(t²+2k)dt=1/3+2k, sidaas darteed k=−1/3 iyo f(x)=x²−2/3.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.prompt: Waa maxay habka ugu toosan ee lagu xaqiijin karo in jawaabta Haeun f(x)=x² ay khaldan tahay?
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.hint.0: Geli f(x)=x² labada dhinac ee isla'egta asalka ah f(x)=x²+2∫₀¹ f(t)dt.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.hint.1: Hubi haddii hubin kasta "had iyo jeer sax u soo baxdo xitaa jawaab khaldan."
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.o.a: Kala-duw f(x)=x² marka loo eego x oo hubi f'(x)=2x
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.r.a: Xalka Haeun horeyba wuxuu u buuxiyaa shuruuddan. Hubintani ma muujiso qaladka.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.o.b: Hubi f(0)=0 oo keliya, oo arag haddii ay waafaqsan tahay k=0 ee f(0)=0+2k isla'egta asalka ah
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.r.b: Haddii f(0)=0, waxay u muuqataa mid waafaqsan k=0, sidaas darteed is-burin ma muuqato. Haddii aadan eegin k adigoo isticmaalaya qiimaha isku-dhejinta cayiman, qaladka ma qabsan kartid.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.o.c: Geli f(x)=x² ∫₀¹ f(t)dt, xisaabi qiimaha, oo barbar dhig k=0
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.r.c: Hubintani waxay si toos ah u xisaabisaa qiimaha isku-dhejinta cayiman oo waxay aragtaa haddii ay waafaqsan tahay qeexidda k.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.o.d: Hubi haddii isticmaalka xarafka kale halkii k uu siinayo isla xalka
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.r.d: Beddelidda magaca xarafka ma beddesho caqliga xalka.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.explain: Haddii f(x)=x², markaas ∫₀¹ t²dt=1/3, sidaas darteed k waa inuu ahaan lahaa 1/3, laakiin Haeun wuxuu yidhi k=0. Labadu ma waafaqsana, sidaas darteed f(x)=x² ma buuxiyo shuruuddii asalka ahayd.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s3.prompt: Qor qoraal gaaban oo loogu talagalay Haeun. Ku dar hal shay oo ay si fiican u sameysay, sababta safka khaldan u khaldan yahay, iyo furaha xalka saxda ah iyo natiijadiisa.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s3.hint.0: Hel hal shay oo sax ahaa xalka Haeun, oo qiyaas fikirkee ayaa safka khaldan ka yimid.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s3.hint.1: Qor tibaaxda loo baahan yahay si loo hagaajiyo safka khaldan (tibaaxda qoraysa k sida isku-dhejin cayiman).
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s3.placeholder: tus., Haeun, ... waa fiican tahay. Laakiin ...
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma marka hore si gaar ah u sheegtay waxa si fiican loo sameeyay?
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma sharaxday in "kala-duwaha joogto waa 0" iyo "qiimaha joogtadu waa 0" ay kala duwan yihiin?
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s3.model.0: Haeun, ka dhigidda isku-dhejinta cayiman k waxay ahayd fikrad fiican! Laakiin "kala-duwaha joogto waa 0" macnaheedu waa natiijada kala-duwidda waa 0, ma aha in qiimaha k yahay 0. Waa inaad helaa k qeexiddiisa, k=∫₀¹(t²+2k)dt=1/3+2k, sidaas darteed k=−1/3, iyo f(x)=x²−2/3.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s3.model.1: Waxay ahayd mid aad u fiican inaad ku bilowdo adigoo ka dhigaya qiimaha aan la xidhiidhin x k. Laakiin k oo ah joogto, si kala-duwihiisu u yahay 0, waa arrin ka duwan k oo leh qiimaha 0. Haddii aad si toos ah u xisaabiso isku-dhejinta cayiman, xallinta k=1/3+2k waxay siinaysaa k=-1/3, sidaas darteed f(x)=x²-2/3.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s3.model.2: Haeun, shaqo fiican. Haddii aad geliso f(x)=x² ee aad ugu dambeyntii heshay ∫₀¹ f(t)dt, waxaad heshaa 1/3, kaas oo aan waafaqsanayn k=0. Waa inaad xisaabisaa qiimaha isku-dhejinta cayiman si aad u go'aamiso k, kadibna k=−1/3 iyo f(x)=x²−2/3.

n-m-h2-integ-08.title: Haddii aan gooyno bartamaha inta u dhexeysa, bedku sidoo kale ma u kala bar baa?
n-m-h2-integ-08.topic: Kala bar bedka iyo isku-dhejinta cayiman
n-m-h2-integ-08.goal: Hubi oo sharax, adigoo isticmaalaya xisaabinta isku-dhejinta cayiman iyo tusaale aad naftaada dhisato, in gooynta bartamaha inta u dhexeysa aysan bedka u kala bixin, iyo in meesha gooynta ay u dhaqaaqdo dhinaca shaqadu ka weyn tahay.
n-m-h2-integ-08.material: Waxaa jira qaab ay ku xidhan yihiin xariiqda y=2x, dhidibka x, iyo labada xariiq x=1 iyo x=7. Sua wuxuu yidhi, "Haddii aad sawirto xariiq toosan x=4, bartamaha inta u dhexeysa 1≤x≤7, bedku wuu u kala baxaa," Dohyeon na wuxuu yidhi, "Aan ku hubinno isku-dhejin cayiman."
n-m-h2-integ-08.thinking.0: Tijaabinta sheegasho dareen ah adigoo isticmaalaya tirooyin
n-m-h2-integ-08.thinking.2: Ku xidhidda qaabka garaafka iyo qaybinta bedka
n-m-h2-integ-08.prereq.1: Helidda qiimayaasha buuxinaya isla'eg gudaha tirooyinka dhan
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.prompt: Sidee ayuu xariiqda toosan x=4 u kala qaybiyaa bedka qaabka?
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.hint.0: Barbar dhig dhererka qaybta bidix iyo qaybta midig ee qaabka iyadoo x=4 loo isticmaalayo xariiqda kala qaybinta.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.hint.1: Xisaabi oo barbar dhig isku-dhejinta cayiman ee labada qaybood, ∫₁⁴ 2x dx iyo ∫₄⁷ 2x dx.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.o.a: Waa u kala baxaa: sababtoo ah inta bidix iyo midig waxay leeyihiin ballaadh isku mid ah
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.r.a: Xitaa ballaadh isku mid ah, haddii dhererrada kala duwan yihiin, bedyadu way kala duwan yihiin. Inta midig xariiqdu way ka sarraysaa.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.o.b: Waa u kala baxaa: sababtoo ah waa xariiq, sidaas darteed dhererku waa joogto inta u dhexeysa kasta
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.r.b: Dhererka y=2x wuu is beddelaa x. Dhererku waa joogto y=joogto oo keliya.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.o.c: Ma u kala baxo: sababtoo ah qaybta midig way ka hooseysaa, sidaas darteed bedka bidix waa ka weyn yahay
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.r.c: Xariiqdu waxay sii sarreysaa dhinaca midig, sidaas darteed dhinaca midig wuxuu leeyahay bed ka weyn.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.o.d: Ma u kala baxo: sababtoo ah dhererku wuu kordhaa dhinaca midig, sidaas darteed qaybta midig way ka weyn tahay
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.r.d: Waxaad isticmaashay xaqiiqda ah bed badan ayaa ku uruurta dhinaca dhererku ka weyn yahay.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.explain: ∫₁⁴ 2x dx=16−1=15 iyo ∫₄⁷ 2x dx=49−16=33. Bidix waa 15 midig na waa 33, sidaas darteed ma u kala baxo, midigna way ka weyn tahay.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s2.prompt: Gali laba saddexyo oo kala duwan oo tirooyin dhan (a, b, k) si xariiqda toosan x=k ay saxda ah u kala qaybiso bedka u dhexeeya y=2x, dhidibka x, iyo labada xariiq toosan x=a iyo x=b. (1≤a<k<b≤50)
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s2.hint.0: Qor isku-dhejinta cayiman ee qaybta bidix iyo qaybta midig ee x=k marka loo eego a, b, k.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s2.hint.1: Fududee isla'egta oranaysa labada qiime waa siman yihiin oo tijaabi isku-darka tirooyinka dhan.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s2.fail.c1: Waa inay noqdaan tirooyin dhan oo leh 1≤a<k<b≤50.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s2.ok.c2: Bedyada bidix iyo midig ee x=k waa siman yihiin.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Bedka bidix iyo bedka midig ma siman yihiin. Muuji ∫ₐᵏ 2x dx iyo ∫ₖᵇ 2x dx marka loo eego a, b, k.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s2.explain: ∫ₐᵏ 2x dx=k²−a² iyo ∫ₖᵇ 2x dx=b²−k², sidaas darteed k²−a²=b²−k², taasi waa, 2k²=a²+b². Tusaale ahaan, (1, 7, 5) wuxuu siinayaa 25−1=24=49−25.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.prompt: Saddexyada aad heshay, k ma ka weyn yahay mise ka yar yahay bartamaha (celceliska) a iyo b? Sharax sababta, adigoo ku xidhaya qaabka y=2x.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.hint.0: Saddex kasta oo aad heshay, hel celceliska (a+b)/2 oo barbar dhig k.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.hint.1: Xusuuso dhinacee ayaa leh bedka ka weyn marka dhexda laga jaro.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.placeholder: Tusaale: k waa ... ka dhexda. Tani waa sababtoo ah ...
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma barbar dhigtay bedka qaybta bidix iyo qaybta midig dhexda?
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma tiri, sabab leh, jihada ay meesha laba-u-qaybinta u dhaqaaqdo?
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.model.0: k wuu ka weyn yahay celceliska. Xariiqdu midigta ayay u sii kor kacdaa, sidaas darteed haddii aad dhexda jarto, bedka midig wuu ka weyn yahay. Sidaas darteed si bedka u qaybsamo badh, waa inaad xariiqda jarista u dhaqaajisaa midigta dhexda.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.model.1: Gudaha (1,7,5), celcelisku waa 4 laakiin k=5, sidaas darteed k wuu ka weyn yahay. Bed badan ayaa ku uruurta dhinaca dherer weyn, sidaas darteed xariiqda laba-u-qaybinta waxay u dhaqaaqdaa midigta.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.model.2: k ee laba-u-qaybiya wuxuu ku yaal midigta barta dhexe ee a iyo b. Tani waa sababtoo ah y=2x midigta ayuu ka sarreeyaa, sidaas darteed haddii aad dhexda jarto, qaybta midig way weyn tahay.

n-m-h2-integ-09.title: Ma heli karnaa bedka si fudud xitaa haddii qaabku ku adag yahay?
n-m-h2-integ-09.topic: Bedka u dhexeeya laba qalooc: farqiga dherer
n-m-h2-integ-09.goal: Fahan in bedka u dhexeeya laba qalooc, mid ka mid ahi uu yahay kan kale oo kor loo wareejiyey, uu go'aansan yahay farqiga dherer iyo ballaadhka dhexda oo keliya, oo si isku mid ah dhis tusaalayaal buuxiya shuruud iyo dhibaato cusub.
n-m-h2-integ-09.material: Waxaa jira qalooca y=x³−3x iyo qalooca y=x³−3x+4, kaas oo ah qalooca kor loo wareejiyey 4. Waxaan rabnaa inaan helno bedka u dhexeeya labada qalooc dhexda 0≤x≤3. (Dhexdan, qalooca koowaad wuxuu sidoo kale leeyahay qayb ka hooseeya ulaha x.)
n-m-h2-integ-09.thinking.0: Yaraynta xisaabta adigoo eegaya qaab dhismeedka (farqiga) ee odhaahyada
n-m-h2-integ-09.thinking.1: Ha ku xidhnaan xiriirka ulaha x
n-m-h2-integ-09.prereq.0: Bedka u dhexeeya laba qalooc = ∫(odhaah sare − odhaah hoose)
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s1.prompt: Dooro xukunka sax ah ee ku saabsan bedka u dhexeeya labada qalooc.
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s1.hint.0: Go'aami kee ka mid ah labada qalooc ayaa kor ah, oo ka jar odhaahda hoose odhaahda sare.
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s1.hint.1: Fududee odhaahda kadib ka jarista oo eeg odhaahda aad hesho.
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s1.o.a: 12: farqiga dhererku waa joogto 4 meel kasta, sidaas darteed ku dhufo ballaadhka 3
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad isticmaashay qaab dhismeedka ah odhaah sare laga jaray odhaah hoose waa joogto 4.
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s1.o.b: 4: labada qalooc waa 4 kala fog yihiin, sidaas darteed qiimahaas waa bedka
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s1.r.b: Farqiga dhererku waa 4, laakiin bed waa inaad sidoo kale ku dhufataa ballaadhka dhexda.
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s1.o.c: 0: qalooca koowaad wuxuu ka hooseeyaa ulaha x, wuxuu noqdaa taban, oo is-baabi'iya
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s1.r.c: Bedka u dhexeeya laba qalooc waxaa go'aamiya odhaah sare − odhaah hoose, ma aha xiriirka ulaha x. Farqigani mar walba waa togan.
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s1.o.d: Lama ogaan karo: waa inaan marka hore xisaabino integral-ka go'an ee x³−3x
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s1.r.d: Gudaha odhaah sare − odhaah hoose, x³−3x way is-baabi'iyaan, sidaas darteed xisaab looma baahna.
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s1.explain: Ka jarista qalooca hoose qalooca sare waxay siinaysaa (x³−3x+4)−(x³−3x)=4. Sidaas darteed bedku waa ∫₀³ 4 dx=12. Goobta qaloocyada marka loo eego ulaha x muhiim ma aha.
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s2.prompt: Gali saddex lammaane oo kala duwan oo tirooyin dabiici ah (k, w) oo bedka u dhexeeya qalooca y=x² iyo qalooca y=x²+k, kaas oo ah kan kor loo wareejiyey k, uu yahay si sax ah 24 dhexda 0≤x≤w. (1≤k≤24, 1≤w≤24)
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore qor farqiga dherer ee u dhexeeya labada qalooc sida odhaah.
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s2.hint.1: Isku dar farqigaas laga bilaabo 0 ilaa w, ku qor marka loo eego k iyo w, oo barbar dhig 24.
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s2.ok.c1: Waa tirooyin dabiici ah baaxadda gudaheeda.
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s2.fail.c1: k iyo w waa inay noqdaan tirooyin dabiici ah oo 1 ilaa 24.
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s2.ok.c2: Bedka u dhexeeya labada qalooc waa 24.
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s2.fail.c2: Bedku ma aha 24. Marka hore fududee (odhaah sare − odhaah hoose).
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s2.explain: Maadaama (x²+k)−x²=k, bedku waa ∫₀ʷ k dx=kw. Lammaanayaasha tirooyinka dabiiciga ah ee leh kw=24 waa (1,24), (2,12), (3,8), (4,6), (6,4), (8,3), (12,2), (24,1). Qaabka qalooca x² ma saameeyo jawaabta.
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s3.prompt: Markan, naftaada dooro qalooca y=g(x). Hal weedh ku qor dhibaato halka bedka u dhexeeya laba qalooc yahay 18, oo sharax sababta dhibaatadaas loo xallin karo adigoon helin integral-ka go'an ee g(x).
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s3.hint.0: Way fudud tahay in la sameeyo dhibaatada haddii aad marka hore dooratid laba lambar oo wax-isku-dhufashadoodu (farqiga dherer jeer ballaadhka dhexda) yahay 18, ka dibna dooro qalooca.
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s3.hint.1: Ka jar odhaahyada labada qalooc oo hubi waxa ku dhaca g(x).
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s3.placeholder: Tusaale: Dhibaato: ... Xal: farqiga dhererku waa ... ballaadhkuna waa ..., sidaas darteed ...
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Dhibaatadaadu ma ka kooban tahay labada qalooc iyo dhexda?
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma tiri marka aad ka jarto labada odhaah, g(x) way baxdaa?
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s3.model.0: Dhibaato: Hel bedka u dhexeeya qaloocyada y=x³−x iyo y=x³−x+3 dhexda 0≤x≤6. Farqiga dherer ee u dhexeeya labada qalooc waa joogto 3 meel kasta ballaadhka dhexdana waa 6, sidaas darteed bedku waa 3×6=18, oo looma baahna in la isku daro x³−x.
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s3.model.1: Dhibaato: Waa maxay bedka ay xidhaan y=2x² iyo y=2x²+2 dhexda 1≤x≤10? Ka jarista odhaahda hoose odhaahda sare waxay ka tagaysaa 2 oo keliya, sidaas darteed farqiga dherer mar walba waa 2. Ku dhufashada ballaadhka 9 waxay siinaysaa 18, sidaas darteed ma u baahnid inaad isku darto g(x).
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s3.model.2: Haddii aad dooratid g(x)=x³−5x oo aad samayso dhibaato weydiinaysa bedka u dhexeeya iyo qalooca kor loo wareejiyey 1 dhexda 0≤x≤18, farqiga dherer waa joogto 1 ballaadhkuna waa 18, sidaas darteed bedku waa 18. Tani waa sababtoo ah g way baxdaa marka la ka jaro.

n-m-h2-seq-01.title: Hubinta xalka Hayoon ee saamiga guud
n-m-h2-seq-01.topic: Wadarta isku xigga juqraafi ah iyo helista saamiga guud
n-m-h2-seq-01.goal: Xal isticmaalaya qaacidada wadarta juqraafi ah, hel xukunka tuuraya xal, kadibna sax adigoo qoraya isku xiggii dhabta ahaa ee leh qiimaha la tuuray oo hubinaya shuruudda.
n-m-h2-seq-01.material: Kani waa xalka Hayoon ee helista saamiga guud ee isku xigga juqraafi {aₙ} oo leh eraygii ugu horreeyay 2 oo wadartiisa laga bilaabo eraygii koowaad ilaa saddexaad ay tahay 6. (aₙ waa "a sub n," r waa saamiga guud, S₃-na waa wadarta 3-da erey ee ugu horreeya.)
n-m-h2-seq-01.thinking.0: Hubinta qiimayntee saf kasta lagu qoray
n-m-h2-seq-01.thinking.1: Hubinta adigoo qiimaha la tuuray si toos ah u gelinaya shuruudda
n-m-h2-seq-01.thinking.2: U kala qaybinta kiisas intaan la isticmaalin qaacidada
n-m-h2-seq-01.prereq.0: Eraygii guud ee isku xigga juqraafi iyo qaacidada wadarta n erey ee ugu horreeya
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s1.prompt: Dooro hal saf oo ku jira xalka Hayoon oo xukun khaldan ka kooban. (Haddii in ka badan hal saf uu khaldan yahay, dooridda mid kasta waa fiican tahay.)
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s1.hint.0: Saf kasta, hubi haddii tibaaxda loo isticmaali karo r kasta ama ay macno la'aan noqoto r qaar.
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s1.hint.1: Qiime kasta oo r ah ee ka muuqda xalka, qor isku xigga leh saamigaas guud oo tijaabi haddii wadarta 3-da erey ee ugu horreeya ay tahay 6.
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s1.line.0: Ha noqdo saamiga guud r. Qaacidada wadarta juqraafi ah, S₃ = 2(r³−1)/(r−1) = 6.
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s1.line.1: Maadaama (r³−1)/(r−1) = r²+r+1, waxaan helnaa r²+r+1 = 3, taasi waa, r²+r−2 = 0.
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s1.line.3: Laakiin haddii r = 1, hooseeyaha r−1 waa 0 tibaaxduna ma qabato, sidaas darteed waan tuuraynaa r = 1. Sidaas darteed saamiga guud waa −2 oo keliya.
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s1.explain: Haddii saamiga guud yahay 1, qaacidada wadarta a(rⁿ−1)/(r−1) lama isticmaali karo. Safka koowaad wuxuu isticmaalay qaacidada isagoo aan kiiskaas si gooni ah u maaraynin, safka ugu dambeeyana wuxuu tuuray r=1 sababtoo ah "lama gelin karo qaacidada." Laakiin haddii r=1, isku xiggu waa 2, 2, 2, … wadarta 3-da erey ee ugu horreeya na waa 6, sidaas darteed wuxuu buuxiyaa shuruudda. Sidaas darteed saamiga guud waa −2 ama 1.
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s2.prompt: Muuji sababta tuurista r=1 ay khaldan tahay adigoo qoraya isku xigga r=1, oo qor dhammaan saamiyada guud ee sax ah.
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s2.hint.0: Qor saddexda erey ee ugu horreeya ee isku xigga leh saamiga guud ee qiimaha r ee la tuuray.
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s2.hint.1: Isku dar saddexdaas erey oo barbar dhig wadarta shuruudda, kadibna ka fikir kiiska ay ahayd in si gooni ah loo baaro intaan la isticmaalin qaacidada.
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s2.placeholder: Tusaale: haddii saamiga guud yahay 1, isku xiggu waa ..., sidaas darteed ...

n-m-h2-seq-07.title: Maxaa laga jarista 3 ay u siinayso isku xigga joomatari?
n-m-h2-seq-07.goal: Fahan sababta, marka la xallinayo dib-u-soo-noqosho, ka jarista qiimaha aan isbeddelin ay u beddesho isku xigga joomatari, oo mar kale u sharax saaxiib dugsiga dhexe ah si sababtu u muuqato.
n-m-h2-seq-07.material:
Shaybaar ayaa koriyaa bakteeriyo. Bilowgii waxaa jira 5, saacad kasta tirada way labajeertaa ka dibna 3 ayaa laga saaraa. Tirada aₙ saacadda n (iyadoo a₁=5 saacadda koowaad), aₙ₊₁ = 2aₙ − 3. Hoos waxaa ah qoraalka xalka arday wayn. 
 Qoraal: Laga bilaabo x = 2x − 3, x = 3. Sidaas darteed aₙ₊₁ − 3 = 2(aₙ − 3). Ha noqoto bₙ = aₙ − 3. Markaas b₁ = 2 iyo bₙ = 2ⁿ. Sidaas darteed aₙ = 2ⁿ + 3.
n-m-h2-seq-07.thinking.0: Ogaanshaha waxa saf kasta oo xalka ka mid ahi qabto
n-m-h2-seq-07.thinking.1: Dib u qorista xal aan lahayn sababo si sababuhu u muuqdaan
n-m-h2-seq-07.thinking.2: Qorista sharaxaad ku habboon heerka dhegaystaha
n-m-h2-seq-07.prereq.0: Eraygii guud ee isku xigxig joomatari ah
n-m-h2-seq-07.s.s1.prompt: Maxay "x = 2x − 3, sidaas darteed x = 3" ee qoraalka u raadinayso?
n-m-h2-seq-07.s.s1.hint.0: Geli 3 halkii aₙ ee recurrence-ka oo xisaabi waxa aₙ₊₁ noqonayo.
n-m-h2-seq-07.s.s1.hint.1: Barbar dhig natiijadaas iyo waxaad heshid marka aad geliso qiime kale (tusaale, 5).
n-m-h2-seq-07.s.s1.r.a: a₁ waxaa la bixiyay inuu yahay 5. Mar kale eeg halka 3 ka yimid.
n-m-h2-seq-07.s.s1.o.b: Helista eraygii guud ee isku xigxigga isla markiiba
n-m-h2-seq-07.s.s1.r.b: x=3 waa hal lambar oo keliya, ma aha tibaax ku xidhan n.
n-m-h2-seq-07.s.s1.o.c: Helista qiime sii ahaada isku mid xitaa ka dib hal saac
n-m-h2-seq-07.s.s1.r.c: Waxaad ka fikirtay xaqiiqda ah haddii aₙ=3 markaas aₙ₊₁=2·3−3=3, sidaas darteed waa qiime aan isbeddelin.
n-m-h2-seq-07.s.s1.r.d: Saamiga guud waa 2. Hubi in 3 aanu ahayn saamiga guud.
n-m-h2-seq-07.s.s1.explain: Xalka x=3 ee x=2x−3 waa lambar aan isbeddelin marka lagu geliyo recurrence-ka, sababtoo ah haddii aₙ=3 markaas aₙ₊₁=3. Ka jarida qiimahan waxay ka saaraysaa qaybta aan isbeddelin, oo waxay ka tagaysaa "labalaabid" oo keliya, sidaas darteed waxay noqotaa isku xigxig joomatari ah.
n-m-h2-seq-07.s.s2.prompt: Dib u qor qoraalka sidii adigoo u sharaxaya saaxiib dugsiga dhexe. Waa inuu muujiyaa noocee lambar ayuu yahay "3" iyo sababta ka jarida 3 aₙ ay dhibaatada uga dhigto mid fudud.
n-m-h2-seq-07.s.s2.hint.0: Xisaabi immisa bakteeriya ayaa jiri doona hal saac ka dib haddii tirada ay tahay 3, oo geli sheekadaada.
n-m-h2-seq-07.s.s2.hint.1: Qor hal jumlad sida isku xigxigga cusub, oo laga jaray 3, u isbeddelo saac kasta.
n-m-h2-seq-07.s.s2.placeholder: Tusaale: Marka hore, hel lambarka ... Ka jar lambarkaas oo ...
n-m-h2-seq-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma sharaxday adigoo aan isticmaalin erayo saaxiibkaa aan aqoon (ereyo sida fixed point)?

n-m-h2-seq-10.topic: Eraygii guud ee isku xigxig farqi ah iyo baaxadda wadarka
n-m-h2-seq-10.goal: Tijaabi laba musharax oo eraygii guud ee laga helay recurrence adigoo isticmaalaya qiyamka yaryar ee n si aad u kala saarto, oo ku sharax erayo gaar ah sababta wadarka farqiyadu u socdo ilaa n−1.
n-m-h2-seq-10.material:
Laba arday ayaa mid walba helay eraygii guud ee isku xigxigga {aₙ} oo leh a₁=2 iyo aₙ₊₁ = aₙ + (3n − 1).
Harin: aₙ = 2 + Σ(k=1 ilaa n−1)(3k−1) = (3n²−5n+6)/2
Doyun: aₙ = 2 + Σ(k=1 ilaa n)(3k−1) = (3n²+n+4)/2
